                ax8.set_yticks(range(len(top_missing)))
                ax8.set_yticklabels(top_missing.index)
                ax8.set_xlabel('Missing Values Count')
                ax8.set_title('Missing Data by Column (Top 10)')
                
                # Add value labels
                for i, (bar, value) in enumerate(zip(bars, top_missing.values)):
                    ax8.text(value + max(top_missing.values) * 0.01, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2.,
                            f'{value}', ha='left', va='center')
            else:
                ax8.text(0.5, 0.5, 'No Missing\nData Detected', 
                        ha='center', va='center', transform=ax8.transAxes)
                ax8.set_title('Missing Data Analysis')
        else:
            ax8.text(0.5, 0.5, 'No DataFrame\nProvided', 
                    ha='center', va='center', transform=ax8.transAxes)
            ax8.set_title('Missing Data Analysis')
        
        # 9. Usage and Limitations
        ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[3, :2])
        ax9.axis('off')
        
        usage_text = "INTENDED USES:\n"
        for i, use in enumerate(datasheet.uses.potential_uses[:3], 1):
            usage_text += f"{i}. {use}\n"
        
        usage_text += "\nINAPPROPRIATE USES:\n"
        for i, misuse in enumerate(datasheet.uses.inappropriate_uses[:3], 1):
            usage_text += f"{i}. {misuse}\n"
        
        ax9.text(0.05, 0.95, usage_text, transform=ax9.transAxes, fontsize=9,
                verticalalignment='top', 
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.5", facecolor="lightgreen", alpha=0.7))
        
        # 10. Maintenance and Updates
        ax10 = fig.add_subplot(gs[3, 2:])
        ax10.axis('off')
        
        maintenance_text = f"""
MAINTENANCE INFO
Maintainer: {datasheet.maintenance.maintainer}
Update Frequency: {datasheet.maintenance.update_frequency}
Versioning: {datasheet.maintenance.versioning_scheme}
License: {datasheet.distribution.license}
Contact: {datasheet.distribution.contact_information}
        """
        
        ax10.text(0.05, 0.95, maintenance_text, transform=ax10.transAxes, fontsize=9,
                 verticalalignment='top', fontfamily='monospace',
                 bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.5", facecolor="lightcyan", alpha=0.7))
        
        plt.suptitle(f'Dataset Documentation Dashboard: {datasheet.dataset_name}', 
                    fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
        
        if save_path:
            plt.savefig(save_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
        plt.show()
    
    @staticmethod
    def create_quality_analysis_chart(datasheet: Datasheet, save_path: Optional[str] = None):
        """Create detailed quality analysis visualization"""
        
        fig, ((ax1, ax2), (ax3, ax4)) = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(15, 10))
        
        # 1. Quality Metrics Radar Chart
        quality_metrics = datasheet.quality_assessment.quality_metrics
        if quality_metrics:
            categories = list(quality_metrics.keys())
            values = list(quality_metrics.values())
            
            # Create radar chart
            angles = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, len(categories), endpoint=False).tolist()
            values += values[:1]  # Complete the circle
            angles += angles[:1]
            
            ax1.plot(angles, values, 'o-', linewidth=2, color='blue')
            ax1.fill(angles, values, alpha=0.25, color='blue')
            ax1.set_xticks(angles[:-1])
            ax1.set_xticklabels(categories)
            ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)
            ax1.set_title('Quality Metrics Radar Chart')
            ax1.grid(True)
        else:
            ax1.text(0.5, 0.5, 'No Quality\nMetrics Available', 
                    ha='center', va='center', transform=ax1.transAxes)
            ax1.set_title('Quality Metrics')
        
        # 2. Completeness Analysis
        completeness_score = datasheet.quality_assessment.completeness_score
        missing_pct = datasheet.composition.missing_data_percentage
        
        categories = ['Complete Data', 'Missing Data']
        sizes = [100 - missing_pct, missing_pct]
        colors = ['green', 'red']
        
        wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(sizes, labels=categories, colors=colors, 
                                          autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90)
        ax2.set_title(f'Data Completeness\n(Score: {completeness_score:.3f})')
        
        # 3. Known Issues
        known_issues = datasheet.quality_assessment.known_issues
        if known_issues:
            issue_types = {}
            for issue in known_issues:
                if 'missing' in issue.lower():
                    issue_types['Missing Data'] = issue_types.get('Missing Data', 0) + 1
                elif 'duplicate' in issue.lower():
                    issue_types['Duplicates'] = issue_types.get('Duplicates', 0) + 1
                elif 'invalid' in issue.lower():
                    issue_types['Invalid Values'] = issue_types.get('Invalid Values', 0) + 1
                else:
                    issue_types['Other'] = issue_types.get('Other', 0) + 1
            
            if issue_types:
                bars = ax3.bar(issue_types.keys(), issue_types.values(), 
                              color='orange', alpha=0.7)
                ax3.set_title('Known Issues by Type')
                ax3.set_ylabel('Count')
                ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
                
                # Add value labels
                for bar, value in zip(bars, issue_types.values()):
                    height = bar.get_height()
                    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.05,
                            f'{value}', ha='center', va='bottom')
        else:
            ax3.text(0.5, 0.5, 'No Known\nIssues Reported', 
                    ha='center', va='center', transform=ax3.transAxes, 
                    bbox=dict(boxstyle="round", facecolor="lightgreen", alpha=0.7))
            ax3.set_title('Known Issues')
        
        # 4. Data Collection Summary
        collection_info = [
            f"Method: {datasheet.collection_process.collection_method.value}",
            f"Timeframe: {datasheet.collection_process.collection_timeframe}",
            f"Location: {datasheet.collection_process.collection_location}",
            f"Instances: {datasheet.composition.total_instances:,}",
            f"Features: {datasheet.composition.feature_count}",
            f"Duplicates: {datasheet.composition.duplicate_instances}"
        ]
        
        ax4.axis('off')
        collection_text = "DATA COLLECTION SUMMARY\n\n" + "\n".join(collection_info)
        ax4.text(0.05, 0.95, collection_text, transform=ax4.transAxes, fontsize=10,
                verticalalignment='top', fontfamily='monospace',
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.5", facecolor="lightblue", alpha=0.7))
        
        plt.tight_layout()
        
        if save_path:
            plt.savefig(save_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
        plt.show()

    class AdvancedDatasheetFeatures:
        @staticmethod
        def add_lineage_tracking(datasheet: Datasheet, source_datasets: List[Dict]) -> Datasheet:
            """Add data lineage tracking"""
            datasheet.additional_info['data_lineage'] = {
                'source_datasets': source_datasets,
                'derivation_process': 'Combination and preprocessing of source datasets',
                'transformation_log': []
            }
            return datasheet
        
        @staticmethod
        def add_version_history(datasheet: Datasheet, version_history: List[Dict]) -> Datasheet:
            """Add version history tracking"""
            datasheet.additional_info['version_history'] = version_history
            return datasheet
        
        @staticmethod
        def add_usage_analytics(datasheet: Datasheet, usage_stats: Dict) -> Datasheet:
            """Add usage analytics"""
            datasheet.additional_info['usage_analytics'] = usage_stats
            return datasheet
        
        @staticmethod
        def calculate_risk_score(datasheet: Datasheet) -> float:
            """Calculate overall risk score for the dataset"""
            risk_factors = {
                'sensitive_info_present': 1 if datasheet.composition.sensitive_information else 0,
                'no_consent': 1 if not datasheet.ethical_considerations.consent_obtained else 0,
                'high_privacy_level': 1 if datasheet.privacy_level in [PrivacyLevel.CONFIDENTIAL, PrivacyLevel.RESTRICTED] else 0,
                'potential_harms': len(datasheet.ethical_considerations.potential_harms) / 10,  # Normalize
                'missing_anonymization': 1 if datasheet.composition.sensitive_information and not datasheet.ethical_considerations.anonymization_methods else 0,
                'low_quality': 1 if datasheet.quality_assessment.completeness_score < 0.7 else 0
            }
            
            # Weighted risk calculation
            weights = {
                'sensitive_info_present': 0.2,
                'no_consent': 0.25,
                'high_privacy_level': 0.15,
                'potential_harms': 0.2,
                'missing_anonymization': 0.15,
                'low_quality': 0.05
            }
            
            risk_score = sum(risk_factors[factor] * weights[factor] for factor in risk_factors)
            return min(risk_score, 1.0)  # Cap at 1.0
        
        @staticmethod
        def generate_compliance_report(datasheet: Datasheet) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            """Generate compliance assessment report"""
            compliance_report = {
                'gdpr_compliance': {
                    'lawful_basis': datasheet.ethical_considerations.consent_obtained,
                    'data_minimization': len(datasheet.composition.sensitive_information) == 0,
                    'purpose_limitation': bool(datasheet.uses.inappropriate_uses),
                    'accuracy': datasheet.quality_assessment.completeness_score > 0.8,
                    'storage_limitation': bool(datasheet.maintenance.retention_policy != "Not specified"),
                    'security': bool(datasheet.ethical_considerations.privacy_protections)
                },
                'hipaa_compliance': {
                    'applicable': 'medical' in datasheet.dataset_name.lower() or 'health' in datasheet.dataset_name.lower(),
                    'phi_identified': any('medical' in col.lower() or 'health' in col.lower() 
                                        for col in datasheet.composition.sensitive_information),
                    'safeguards': bool(datasheet.ethical_considerations.privacy_protections),
                    'access_controls': 'access' in str(datasheet.ethical_considerations.privacy_protections).lower()
                },
                'ccpa_compliance': {
                    'applicable': datasheet.legal_considerations.jurisdiction == 'United States',
                    'consumer_rights': datasheet.ethical_considerations.consent_obtained,
                    'data_categories': bool(datasheet.composition.sensitive_information),
                    'deletion_rights': bool(datasheet.maintenance.retention_policy != "Not specified")
                }
            }
            
            # Calculate overall compliance scores
            for regulation, checks in compliance_report.items():
                if regulation.endswith('_compliance'):
                    applicable_checks = {k: v for k, v in checks.items() if k != 'applicable'}
                    if checks.get('applicable', True):
                        compliance_score = sum(applicable_checks.values()) / len(applicable_checks)
                        compliance_report[regulation]['compliance_score'] = compliance_score
                    else:
                        compliance_report[regulation]['compliance_score'] = 1.0  # N/A
            
            return compliance_report

    class DatasheetComparator:
        @staticmethod
        def compare_datasheets(datasheets: List[Datasheet]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            """Compare multiple datasheets"""
            comparison = {
                'datasets': [ds.dataset_name for ds in datasheets],
                'sizes': [ds.composition.total_instances for ds in datasheets],
                'quality_scores': [ds.quality_assessment.completeness_score for ds in datasheets],
                'risk_scores': [ds.additional_info.get('risk_score', 0) for ds in datasheets],
                'privacy_levels': [ds.privacy_level.value for ds in datasheets],
                'consent_status': [ds.ethical_considerations.consent_obtained for ds in datasheets],
                'summary': {}
            }
            
            # Generate summary statistics
            comparison['summary'] = {
                'total_instances': sum(comparison['sizes']),
                'avg_quality': np.mean(comparison['quality_scores']),
                'avg_risk': np.mean(comparison['risk_scores']),
                'consent_rate': sum(comparison['consent_status']) / len(comparison['consent_status'])
            }
            
            return comparison
        
        @staticmethod
        def visualize_comparison(comparison: Dict, save_path: Optional[str] = None):
            """Create comparison visualization"""
            fig, ((ax1, ax2), (ax3, ax4)) = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(15, 10))
            
            datasets = comparison['datasets']
            
            # 1. Dataset sizes
            ax1.bar(datasets, comparison['sizes'], color='skyblue', alpha=0.7)
            ax1.set_title('Dataset Sizes')
            ax1.set_ylabel('Number of Instances')
            ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
            
            # 2. Quality scores
            ax2.bar(datasets, comparison['quality_scores'], color='green', alpha=0.7)
            ax2.set_title('Quality Scores')
            ax2.set_ylabel('Completeness Score')
            ax2.set_ylim(0, 1)
            ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
            
            # 3. Risk scores
            colors = ['red' if score > 0.7 else 'orange' if score > 0.4 else 'green' 
                     for score in comparison['risk_scores']]
            ax3.bar(datasets, comparison['risk_scores'], color=colors, alpha=0.7)
            ax3.set_title('Risk Scores')
            ax3.set_ylabel('Risk Score')
            ax3.set_ylim(0, 1)
            ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
            
            # 4. Summary metrics
            summary_metrics = ['Avg Quality', 'Avg Risk', 'Consent Rate']
            summary_values = [
                comparison['summary']['avg_quality'],
                comparison['summary']['avg_risk'],
                comparison['summary']['consent_rate']
            ]
            
            bars = ax4.bar(summary_metrics, summary_values, 
                          color=['green', 'red', 'blue'], alpha=0.7)
            ax4.set_title('Summary Metrics')
            ax4.set_ylabel('Score')
            ax4.set_ylim(0, 1)
            
            # Add value labels
            for bar, value in zip(bars, summary_values):
                height = bar.get_height()
                ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.02,
                        f'{value:.3f}', ha='center', va='bottom')
            
            plt.tight_layout()
            
            if save_path:
                plt.savefig(save_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
            plt.show()

This comprehensive Datasheet Pattern implementation provides:

1. **Structured Documentation**: Complete dataset information including motivation, composition, collection, preprocessing,
uses, distribution, maintenance, ethics, and legal considerations
2. **Automated Generation**: Generate datasheets directly from pandas DataFrames with automatic analysis
3. **Multiple Export Formats**: JSON, YAML, and HTML reports for different stakeholders
4. **Validation Framework**: Ensure datasheets meet completeness and quality standards
5. **Visual Dashboards**: Comprehensive visualizations for dataset overview and quality analysis
6. **Template System**: Pre-built templates for common dataset types (survey, image, text, medical)
7. **Advanced Features**: Data lineage tracking, version history, usage analytics, and risk assessment
8. **Compliance Assessment**: Automated evaluation against GDPR, HIPAA, and CCPA requirements
9. **Quality Analysis**: Detailed assessment of data completeness, consistency, and validity
10. **Comparison Framework**: Tools for comparing multiple datasets across key dimensions

The pattern ensures transparent, responsible data management by providing comprehensive documentation that enables informed decision-making about dataset use and helps maintain compliance with data protection regulations. This documentation is essential for reproducible research, ethical AI development, and regulatory compliance.

## 1091. Fact Sheet Pattern

```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from typing import List, Dict, Tuple, Optional, Union, Any
import json
import yaml
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict
from datetime import datetime
from enum import Enum
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import logging
import requests
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod

class FactType(Enum):
    """Types of facts that can be documented"""
    PERFORMANCE = "performance"
    CAPABILITY = "capability"
    LIMITATION = "limitation"
    SAFETY = "safety"
    FAIRNESS = "fairness"
    ROBUSTNESS = "robustness"
    EFFICIENCY = "efficiency"
    COMPLIANCE = "compliance"

class EvidenceLevel(Enum):
    """Levels of evidence supporting facts"""
    VERIFIED = "verified"
    TESTED = "tested"
    OBSERVED = "observed"
    REPORTED = "reported"
    CLAIMED = "claimed"

class FactStatus(Enum):
    """Status of fact verification"""
    CONFIRMED = "confirmed"
    PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED = "partially_confirmed"
    UNCONFIRMED = "unconfirmed"
    CONTRADICTED = "contradicted"
    OUTDATED = "outdated"

@dataclass
class Evidence:
    """Evidence supporting a fact"""
    source: str
    type: str  # experiment, benchmark, study, etc.
    methodology: str
    results: Dict[str, Any]
    confidence: float
    date: str
    reproducible: bool
    peer_reviewed: bool

@dataclass
class Fact:
    """Individual fact about a model or system"""
    id: str
    type: FactType
    statement: str
    evidence: List[Evidence]
    status: FactStatus
    confidence_score: float
    last_verified: str
    context: str
    limitations: List[str]
    related_facts: List[str]

@dataclass
class FactSheetMetadata:
    """Metadata for the fact sheet"""
    model_name: str
    model_version: str
    fact_sheet_version: str
    creation_date: str
    last_updated: str
    authors: List[str]
    reviewers: List[str]
    approval_status: str

@dataclass
class FactSheet:
    """Complete fact sheet for AI model/system"""
    metadata: FactSheetMetadata
    facts: List[Fact]
    summary: Dict[str, Any]
    verification_log: List[Dict[str, Any]]
    additional_info: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    
    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Convert fact sheet to dictionary"""
        return asdict(self)
    
    def to_json(self, filepath: str = None) -> str:
        """Export fact sheet to JSON"""
        sheet_dict = self.to_dict()
        sheet_dict = self._convert_enums_to_strings(sheet_dict)
        
        json_str = json.dumps(sheet_dict, indent=2, default=str)
        
        if filepath:
            with open(filepath, 'w') as f:
                f.write(json_str)
        
        return json_str
    
    def to_yaml(self, filepath: str = None) -> str:
        """Export fact sheet to YAML"""
        sheet_dict = self.to_dict()
        sheet_dict = self._convert_enums_to_strings(sheet_dict)
        
        yaml_str = yaml.dump(sheet_dict, default_flow_style=False, sort_keys=False)
        
        if filepath:
            with open(filepath, 'w') as f:
                f.write(yaml_str)
        
        return yaml_str
    
    def _convert_enums_to_strings(self, obj):
        """Recursively convert enums to strings"""
        if isinstance(obj, dict):
            return {k: self._convert_enums_to_strings(v) for k, v in obj.items()}
        elif isinstance(obj, list):
            return [self._convert_enums_to_strings(item) for item in obj]
        elif isinstance(obj, Enum):
            return obj.value
        else:
            return obj

class FactVerifier(ABC):
    """Abstract base class for fact verification"""
    
    def __init__(self, name: str):
        self.name = name
    
    @abstractmethod
    def verify_fact(self, fact: Fact, model: nn.Module = None, 
                   data: Any = None) -> Tuple[FactStatus, float, str]:
        """Verify a fact and return status, confidence, and explanation"""
        pass

class PerformanceFactVerifier(FactVerifier):
    """Verifier for performance-related facts"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__("Performance Fact Verifier")
    
    def verify_fact(self, fact: Fact, model: nn.Module = None, 
                   data: Any = None) -> Tuple[FactStatus, float, str]:
        """Verify performance facts"""
        if fact.type != FactType.PERFORMANCE:
            return FactStatus.UNCONFIRMED, 0.0, "Not a performance fact"
        
        if not model or data is None:
            return FactStatus.UNCONFIRMED, 0.0, "Model or data not provided"
        
        try:
            # Extract claimed performance from fact statement
            claimed_metrics = self._extract_performance_claims(fact.statement)
            
            # Evaluate model performance
            actual_metrics = self._evaluate_model_performance(model, data)
            
            # Compare claimed vs actual
            verification_results = self._compare_performance(claimed_metrics, actual_metrics)
            
            status, confidence = self._determine_verification_status(verification_results)
            explanation = self._generate_explanation(verification_results)
            
            return status, confidence, explanation
            
        except Exception as e:
            return FactStatus.UNCONFIRMED, 0.0, f"Verification failed: {str(e)}"
    
    def _extract_performance_claims(self, statement: str) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """Extract performance metrics from fact statement"""
        import re
        
        claims = {}
        
        # Common patterns for performance metrics
        patterns = {
            'accuracy': r'accuracy[:\s]+(\d+\.?\d*)%?',
            'precision': r'precision[:\s]+(\d+\.?\d*)%?',
            'recall': r'recall[:\s]+(\d+\.?\d*)%?',
            'f1': r'f1[:\s]+(\d+\.?\d*)%?',
            'auc': r'auc[:\s]+(\d+\.?\d*)%?'
        }
        
        for metric, pattern in patterns.items():
            match = re.search(pattern, statement.lower())
            if match:
                value = float(match.group(1))
                # Convert percentage to decimal if needed
                if value > 1:
                    value = value / 100
                claims[metric] = value
        
        return claims
    
    def _evaluate_model_performance(self, model: nn.Module, data: Any) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """Evaluate actual model performance"""
        from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score, f1_score, roc_auc_score
        
        model.eval()
        all_predictions = []
        all_labels = []
        all_probabilities = []
        
        with torch.no_grad():
            for batch in data:
                if isinstance(batch, (list, tuple)) and len(batch) >= 2:
                    inputs, labels = batch[0], batch[1]
                else:
                    continue
                
                outputs = model(inputs)
                
                if outputs.dim() > 1 and outputs.size(1) > 1:
                    # Multi-class classification
                    probabilities = torch.softmax(outputs, dim=1)
                    predictions = torch.argmax(outputs, dim=1)
                    all_probabilities.extend(probabilities[:, 1].cpu().numpy() if probabilities.size(1) == 2 
                                           else probabilities.max(dim=1)[0].cpu().numpy())
                else:
                    # Binary classification
                    probabilities = torch.sigmoid(outputs)
                    predictions = (probabilities > 0.5).long()
                    all_probabilities.extend(probabilities.cpu().numpy())
                
                all_predictions.extend(predictions.cpu().numpy())
                all_labels.extend(labels.cpu().numpy())
        
        # Calculate metrics
        metrics = {}
        if all_predictions and all_labels:
            metrics['accuracy'] = accuracy_score(all_labels, all_predictions)
            
            # Handle binary vs multiclass
            if len(set(all_labels)) == 2:
                metrics['precision'] = precision_score(all_labels, all_predictions, zero_division=0)
                metrics['recall'] = recall_score(all_labels, all_predictions, zero_division=0)
                metrics['f1'] = f1_score(all_labels, all_predictions, zero_division=0)
                
                if all_probabilities:
                    try:
                        metrics['auc'] = roc_auc_score(all_labels, all_probabilities)
                    except:
                        pass
            else:
                metrics['precision'] = precision_score(all_labels, all_predictions, average='macro', zero_division=0)
                metrics['recall'] = recall_score(all_labels, all_predictions, average='macro', zero_division=0)
                metrics['f1'] = f1_score(all_labels, all_predictions, average='macro', zero_division=0)
        
        return metrics
    
    def _compare_performance(self, claimed: Dict[str, float], 
                           actual: Dict[str, float]) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, float]]:
        """Compare claimed vs actual performance"""
        results = {}
        
        for metric in claimed.keys():
            if metric in actual:
                claimed_val = claimed[metric]
                actual_val = actual[metric]
                difference = abs(claimed_val - actual_val)
                relative_error = difference / max(claimed_val, 0.001)
                
                results[metric] = {
                    'claimed': claimed_val,
                    'actual': actual_val,
                    'difference': difference,
                    'relative_error': relative_error,
                    'within_tolerance': difference < 0.05  # 5% tolerance
                }
        
        return results
    
    def _determine_verification_status(self, results: Dict) -> Tuple[FactStatus, float]:
        """Determine verification status and confidence"""
        if not results:
            return FactStatus.UNCONFIRMED, 0.0
        
        within_tolerance = [r['within_tolerance'] for r in results.values()]
        
        if all(within_tolerance):
            return FactStatus.CONFIRMED, 0.9
        elif any(within_tolerance):
            return FactStatus.PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED, 0.6
        else:
            # Check if systematically lower or higher
            differences = [r['actual'] - r['claimed'] for r in results.values()]
            if all(d < -0.1 for d in differences):  # Significantly worse
                return FactStatus.CONTRADICTED, 0.8
            else:
                return FactStatus.UNCONFIRMED, 0.3
    
    def _generate_explanation(self, results: Dict) -> str:
        """Generate explanation for verification results"""
        if not results:
            return "No comparable metrics found"
        
        explanations = []
        for metric, result in results.items():
            claimed = result['claimed']
            actual = result['actual']
            diff = result['difference']
            
            if result['within_tolerance']:
                explanations.append(f"{metric}: {actual:.3f} vs claimed {claimed:.3f} (✓)")
            else:
                explanations.append(f"{metric}: {actual:.3f} vs claimed {claimed:.3f} (diff: {diff:.3f})")
        
        return "; ".join(explanations)

class SafetyFactVerifier(FactVerifier):
    """Verifier for safety-related facts"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__("Safety Fact Verifier")
    
    def verify_fact(self, fact: Fact, model: nn.Module = None, 
                   data: Any = None) -> Tuple[FactStatus, float, str]:
        """Verify safety facts"""
        if fact.type != FactType.SAFETY:
            return FactStatus.UNCONFIRMED, 0.0, "Not a safety fact"
        
        # Analyze fact statement for safety claims
        safety_claims = self._extract_safety_claims(fact.statement)
        
        # Check evidence quality
        evidence_quality = self._assess_evidence_quality(fact.evidence)
        
        # Determine verification status based on evidence
        if evidence_quality > 0.8:
            return FactStatus.CONFIRMED, evidence_quality, "Strong evidence supports safety claims"
        elif evidence_quality > 0.6:
            return FactStatus.PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED, evidence_quality, "Moderate evidence for safety claims"
        elif evidence_quality > 0.3:
            return FactStatus.UNCONFIRMED, evidence_quality, "Insufficient evidence for safety claims"
        else:
            return FactStatus.CONTRADICTED, evidence_quality, "Evidence contradicts safety claims"
    
    def _extract_safety_claims(self, statement: str) -> List[str]:
        """Extract safety-related claims from statement"""
        safety_keywords = ['safe', 'secure', 'robust', 'reliable', 'protected', 'filtered']
        claims = []
        
        statement_lower = statement.lower()
        for keyword in safety_keywords:
            if keyword in statement_lower:
                claims.append(keyword)
        
        return claims
    
    def _assess_evidence_quality(self, evidence_list: List[Evidence]) -> float:
        """Assess quality of evidence supporting safety claims"""
        if not evidence_list:
            return 0.0
        
        quality_scores = []
        for evidence in evidence_list:
            score = evidence.confidence
            
            # Adjust based on evidence characteristics
            if evidence.peer_reviewed:
                score *= 1.2
            if evidence.reproducible:
                score *= 1.1
            if evidence.type in ['experiment', 'benchmark']:
                score *= 1.1
            
            quality_scores.append(min(score, 1.0))
        
        return np.mean(quality_scores)

class FactSheetGenerator:

                           **kwargs) -> FactSheet:

        # Create metadata
        metadata = self._create_metadata(model_info, kwargs)

        facts = self._generate_facts_from_results(evaluation_results, model_info)
        
        # Add manually specified facts
        manual_facts = kwargs.get('manual_facts', [])
        facts.extend(manual_facts)
        
        # Create summary
        summary = self._create_summary(facts)
        
        # Initialize verification log
        verification_log = []
        
        return Fact
```python
        return FactSheet(
            metadata=metadata,
            facts=facts,
            summary=summary,
            verification_log=verification_log,
            additional_info=kwargs.get('additional_info', {})
        )
    
    def _create_metadata(self, model_info: Dict[str, Any], kwargs: Dict) -> FactSheetMetadata:
        """Create fact sheet metadata"""
        return FactSheetMetadata(
            model_name=model_info.get('name', 'Unnamed Model'),
            model_version=model_info.get('version', '1.0.0'),
            fact_sheet_version=kwargs.get('fact_sheet_version', '1.0.0'),
            creation_date=datetime.now().isoformat(),
            last_updated=datetime.now().isoformat(),
            authors=kwargs.get('authors', ['Unknown']),
            reviewers=kwargs.get('reviewers', []),
            approval_status=kwargs.get('approval_status', 'Draft')
        )
    
    def _generate_facts_from_results(self, evaluation_results: Dict[str, Any], 
                                   model_info: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[Fact]:
        """Generate facts from evaluation results"""
        facts = []
        
        # Performance facts
        if 'performance' in evaluation_results:
            perf_results = evaluation_results['performance']
            for metric, value in perf_results.items():
                if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
                    fact = self._create_performance_fact(metric, value, model_info)
                    facts.append(fact)
        
        # Safety facts
        if 'safety' in evaluation_results:
            safety_results = evaluation_results['safety']
            safety_fact = self._create_safety_fact(safety_results, model_info)
            facts.append(safety_fact)
        
        # Fairness facts
        if 'fairness' in evaluation_results:
            fairness_results = evaluation_results['fairness']
            fairness_fact = self._create_fairness_fact(fairness_results, model_info)
            facts.append(fairness_fact)
        
        # Robustness facts
        if 'robustness' in evaluation_results:
            robustness_results = evaluation_results['robustness']
            robustness_fact = self._create_robustness_fact(robustness_results, model_info)
            facts.append(robustness_fact)
        
        return facts
    
    def _create_performance_fact(self, metric: str, value: float, 
                               model_info: Dict[str, Any]) -> Fact:
        """Create performance fact"""
        fact_id = f"perf_{metric}_{hashlib.md5(str(value).encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}"
        
        statement = f"Model achieves {metric} of {value:.3f}"
        if metric in ['accuracy', 'precision', 'recall', 'f1']:
            statement += f" ({value*100:.1f}%)"
        
        # Create evidence
        evidence = Evidence(
            source="Internal evaluation",
            type="benchmark",
            methodology=f"Standard {metric} calculation on test set",
            results={metric: value},
            confidence=0.8,
            date=datetime.now().isoformat(),
            reproducible=True,
            peer_reviewed=False
        )
        
        return Fact(
            id=fact_id,
            type=FactType.PERFORMANCE,
            statement=statement,
            evidence=[evidence],
            status=FactStatus.CONFIRMED,
            confidence_score=0.8,
            last_verified=datetime.now().isoformat(),
            context=f"Evaluated on {model_info.get('dataset', 'test dataset')}",
            limitations=["Results may vary on different datasets"],
            related_facts=[]
        )
    
    def _create_safety_fact(self, safety_results: Dict[str, Any], 
                          model_info: Dict[str, Any]) -> Fact:
        """Create safety fact"""
        fact_id = f"safety_{hashlib.md5(str(safety_results).encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}"
        
        # Analyze safety results
        safety_score = safety_results.get('overall_safety_score', 0.0)
        violations = safety_results.get('violations', [])
        
        if safety_score > 0.8 and len(violations) == 0:
            statement = "Model demonstrates high safety standards with no critical violations detected"
            status = FactStatus.CONFIRMED
            confidence = 0.9
        elif safety_score > 0.6:
            statement = f"Model shows moderate safety with {len(violations)} violations detected"
            status = FactStatus.PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED
            confidence = 0.7
        else:
            statement = f"Model has safety concerns with {len(violations)} violations detected"
            status = FactStatus.CONTRADICTED
            confidence = 0.8
        
        evidence = Evidence(
            source="Safety evaluation framework",
            type="safety_audit",
            methodology="Comprehensive safety testing including adversarial examples",
            results=safety_results,
            confidence=confidence,
            date=datetime.now().isoformat(),
            reproducible=True,
            peer_reviewed=False
        )
        
        return Fact(
            id=fact_id,
            type=FactType.SAFETY,
            statement=statement,
            evidence=[evidence],
            status=status,
            confidence_score=confidence,
            last_verified=datetime.now().isoformat(),
            context="Comprehensive safety evaluation",
            limitations=["Safety assessment based on current test scenarios"],
            related_facts=[]
        )
    
    def _create_fairness_fact(self, fairness_results: Dict[str, Any], 
                            model_info: Dict[str, Any]) -> Fact:
        """Create fairness fact"""
        fact_id = f"fairness_{hashlib.md5(str(fairness_results).encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}"
        
        fairness_score = fairness_results.get('overall_fairness_score', 0.0)
        bias_detected = fairness_results.get('bias_detected', False)
        
        if fairness_score > 0.8 and not bias_detected:
            statement = "Model demonstrates fair treatment across demographic groups"
            status = FactStatus.CONFIRMED
            confidence = 0.85
        elif fairness_score > 0.6:
            statement = "Model shows moderate fairness with some bias concerns"
            status = FactStatus.PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED
            confidence = 0.7
        else:
            statement = "Model exhibits significant fairness issues requiring attention"
            status = FactStatus.CONTRADICTED
            confidence = 0.8
        
        evidence = Evidence(
            source="Fairness audit framework",
            type="bias_analysis",
            methodology="Statistical parity and equalized odds analysis",
            results=fairness_results,
            confidence=confidence,
            date=datetime.now().isoformat(),
            reproducible=True,
            peer_reviewed=False
        )
        
        return Fact(
            id=fact_id,
            type=FactType.FAIRNESS,
            statement=statement,
            evidence=[evidence],
            status=status,
            confidence_score=confidence,
            last_verified=datetime.now().isoformat(),
            context="Fairness evaluation across protected attributes",
            limitations=["Fairness assessment limited to available demographic data"],
            related_facts=[]
        )
    
    def _create_robustness_fact(self, robustness_results: Dict[str, Any], 
                              model_info: Dict[str, Any]) -> Fact:
        """Create robustness fact"""
        fact_id = f"robustness_{hashlib.md5(str(robustness_results).encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}"
        
        robustness_score = robustness_results.get('overall_robustness_score', 0.0)
        attack_success_rate = robustness_results.get('attack_success_rate', 0.0)
        
        if robustness_score > 0.8 and attack_success_rate < 0.1:
            statement = "Model demonstrates strong robustness against adversarial attacks"
            status = FactStatus.CONFIRMED
            confidence = 0.85
        elif robustness_score > 0.6:
            statement = f"Model shows moderate robustness with {attack_success_rate:.1%} attack success rate"
            status = FactStatus.PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED
            confidence = 0.7
        else:
            statement = f"Model vulnerable to attacks with {attack_success_rate:.1%} success rate"
            status = FactStatus.CONTRADICTED
            confidence = 0.8
        
        evidence = Evidence(
            source="Adversarial robustness testing",
            type="adversarial_evaluation",
            methodology="FGSM, PGD, and other adversarial attack methods",
            results=robustness_results,
            confidence=confidence,
            date=datetime.now().isoformat(),
            reproducible=True,
            peer_reviewed=False
        )
        
        return Fact(
            id=fact_id,
            type=FactType.ROBUSTNESS,
            statement=statement,
            evidence=[evidence],
            status=status,
            confidence_score=confidence,
            last_verified=datetime.now().isoformat(),
            context="Adversarial robustness evaluation",
            limitations=["Robustness tested against known attack methods only"],
            related_facts=[]
        )
    
    def _create_summary(self, facts: List[Fact]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Create summary of facts"""
        summary = {
            'total_facts': len(facts),
            'facts_by_type': {},
            'facts_by_status': {},
            'average_confidence': 0.0,
            'last_verification': datetime.now().isoformat(),
            'key_findings': []
        }
        
        # Count by type
        for fact_type in FactType:
            count = sum(1 for fact in facts if fact.type == fact_type)
            summary['facts_by_type'][fact_type.value] = count
        
        # Count by status
        for status in FactStatus:
            count = sum(1 for fact in facts if fact.status == status)
            summary['facts_by_status'][status.value] = count
        
        # Average confidence
        if facts:
            summary['average_confidence'] = np.mean([fact.confidence_score for fact in facts])
        
        # Key findings
        confirmed_facts = [fact for fact in facts if fact.status == FactStatus.CONFIRMED]
        contradicted_facts = [fact for fact in facts if fact.status == FactStatus.CONTRADICTED]
        
        summary['key_findings'] = [
            f"{len(confirmed_facts)} facts confirmed",
            f"{len(contradicted_facts)} facts contradicted",
            f"Average confidence: {summary['average_confidence']:.2f}"
        ]
        
        return summary
    
    def verify_facts(self, fact_sheet: FactSheet, model: nn.Module = None, 
                    data: Any = None) -> FactSheet:
        """Verify facts in the fact sheet"""
        verification_log = []
        
        for fact in fact_sheet.facts:
            if fact.type in self.verifiers:
                verifier = self.verifiers[fact.type]
                
                try:
                    status, confidence, explanation = verifier.verify_fact(fact, model, data)
                    
                    # Update fact
                    original_status = fact.status
                    fact.status = status
                    fact.confidence_score = confidence
                    fact.last_verified = datetime.now().isoformat()
                    
                    # Log verification
                    verification_log.append({
                        'fact_id': fact.id,
                        'verifier': verifier.name,
                        'original_status': original_status.value,
                        'new_status': status.value,
                        'confidence': confidence,
                        'explanation': explanation,
                        'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat()
                    })
                    
                except Exception as e:
                    verification_log.append({
                        'fact_id': fact.id,
                        'verifier': verifier.name,
                        'error': str(e),
                        'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat()
                    })
        
        # Update verification log
        fact_sheet.verification_log.extend(verification_log)
        
        # Update summary
        fact_sheet.summary = self._create_summary(fact_sheet.facts)
        fact_sheet.metadata.last_updated = datetime.now().isoformat()
        
        return fact_sheet

class FactSheetValidator:
    """Validator for fact sheet quality and completeness"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.required_fact_types = [FactType.PERFORMANCE, FactType.SAFETY]
        self.minimum_evidence_per_fact = 1
        self.minimum_confidence_threshold = 0.5
    
    def validate(self, fact_sheet: FactSheet) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Validate fact sheet quality"""
        validation_result = {
            'is_valid': True,
            'completeness_score': 0.0,
            'quality_issues': [],
            'recommendations': [],
            'fact_coverage': {},
            'evidence_quality': {}
        }
        
        # Check fact type coverage
        present_types = set(fact.type for fact in fact_sheet.facts)
        missing_types = [ft for ft in self.required_fact_types if ft not in present_types]
        
        if missing_types:
            validation_result['quality_issues'].append(
                f"Missing required fact types: {[t.value for t in missing_types]}"
            )
            validation_result['is_valid'] = False
        
        # Check evidence quality
        facts_without_evidence = [fact for fact in fact_sheet.facts 
                                if len(fact.evidence) < self.minimum_evidence_per_fact]
        
        if facts_without_evidence:
            validation_result['quality_issues'].append(
                f"{len(facts_without_evidence)} facts lack sufficient evidence"
            )
        
        # Check confidence levels
        low_confidence_facts = [fact for fact in fact_sheet.facts 
                              if fact.confidence_score < self.minimum_confidence_threshold]
        
        if low_confidence_facts:
            validation_result['quality_issues'].append(
                f"{len(low_confidence_facts)} facts have low confidence scores"
            )
        
        # Calculate completeness score
        type_coverage = len(present_types) / len(self.required_fact_types)
        evidence_coverage = len([f for f in fact_sheet.facts if f.evidence]) / max(len(fact_sheet.facts), 1)
        confidence_coverage = len([f for f in fact_sheet.facts 
                                 if f.confidence_score >= self.minimum_confidence_threshold]) / max(len(fact_sheet.facts), 1)
        
        validation_result['completeness_score'] = (type_coverage + evidence_coverage + confidence_coverage) / 3
        
        # Generate recommendations
        if validation_result['completeness_score'] < 0.8:
            validation_result['recommendations'].append("Improve fact coverage and evidence quality")
        
        if missing_types:
            validation_result['recommendations'].append(
                f"Add facts for missing types: {[t.value for t in missing_types]}"
            )
        
        if low_confidence_facts:
            validation_result['recommendations'].append(
                "Strengthen evidence for low-confidence facts"
            )
        
        return validation_result

class FactSheetVisualizer:
    """Create visualizations for fact sheets"""
    
    @staticmethod
    def create_fact_sheet_dashboard(fact_sheet: FactSheet, save_path: Optional[str] = None):
        """Create comprehensive fact sheet dashboard"""
        
        fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))
        gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 4, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)
        
        # 1. Fact Sheet Overview
        ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
        ax1.axis('off')
        
        overview_text = f"""
FACT SHEET OVERVIEW
Model: {fact_sheet.metadata.model_name}
Version: {fact_sheet.metadata.model_version}
Fact Sheet Version: {fact_sheet.metadata.fact_sheet_version}
Total Facts: {fact_sheet.summary['total_facts']}
Average Confidence: {fact_sheet.summary['average_confidence']:.3f}
Last Updated: {fact_sheet.metadata.last_updated[:10]}
Status: {fact_sheet.metadata.approval_status}
        """
        
        ax1.text(0.05, 0.95, overview_text, transform=ax1.transAxes, fontsize=11,
                verticalalignment='top', fontfamily='monospace',
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.5", facecolor="lightblue", alpha=0.7))
        
        # 2. Facts by Type
        ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2:])
        fact_types = list(fact_sheet.summary['facts_by_type'].keys())
        type_counts = list(fact_sheet.summary['facts_by_type'].values())
        
        if fact_types and any(count > 0 for count in type_counts):
            # Filter out zero counts
            filtered_types = [(t, c) for t, c in zip(fact_types, type_counts) if c > 0]
            if filtered_types:
                types, counts = zip(*filtered_types)
                colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(types)))
                
                bars = ax2.bar(types, counts, color=colors, alpha=0.7)
                ax2.set_title('Facts by Type')
                ax2.set_ylabel('Count')
                ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
                
                # Add value labels
                for bar, count in zip(bars, counts):
                    height = bar.get_height()
                    ax2.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.05,
                            f'{count}', ha='center', va='bottom')
        else:
            ax2.text(0.5, 0.5, 'No Facts\nAvailable', ha='center', va='center', 
                    transform=ax2.transAxes)
            ax2.set_title('Facts by Type')
        
        # 3. Verification Status
        ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
        status_data = fact_sheet.summary['facts_by_status']
        statuses = [s for s, count in status_data.items() if count > 0]
        status_counts = [count for count in status_data.values() if count > 0]
        
        if statuses:
            colors = {'confirmed': 'green', 'partially_confirmed': 'yellow', 
                     'unconfirmed': 'orange', 'contradicted': 'red', 'outdated': 'gray'}
            pie_colors = [colors.get(status, 'lightblue') for status in statuses]
            
            wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(status_counts, labels=statuses, colors=pie_colors,
                                              autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90)
            ax3.set_title('Verification Status')
        else:
            ax3.text(0.5, 0.5, 'No Status\nData', ha='center', va='center')
            ax3.set_title('Verification Status')
        
        # 4. Confidence Distribution
        ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
        if fact_sheet.facts:
            confidences = [fact.confidence_score for fact in fact_sheet.facts]
            ax4.hist(confidences, bins=10, color='skyblue', alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
            ax4.set_title('Confidence Score Distribution')
            ax4.set_xlabel('Confidence Score')
            ax4.set_ylabel('Count')
            ax4.axvline(x=np.mean(confidences), color='red', linestyle='--', 
                       label=f'Mean: {np.mean(confidences):.3f}')
            ax4.legend()
        else:
            ax4.text(0.5, 0.5, 'No Facts\nAvailable', ha='center', va='center')
            ax4.set_title('Confidence Distribution')
        
        # 5. Evidence Quality Analysis
        ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
        if fact_sheet.facts:
            evidence_counts = [len(fact.evidence) for fact in fact_sheet.facts]
            peer_reviewed = sum(1 for fact in fact_sheet.facts 
                              for evidence in fact.evidence if evidence.peer_reviewed)
            reproducible = sum(1 for fact in fact_sheet.facts 
                             for evidence in fact.evidence if evidence.reproducible)
            total_evidence = sum(evidence_counts)
            
            categories = ['Peer Reviewed', 'Reproducible', 'Other']
            values = [peer_reviewed, reproducible, max(0, total_evidence - peer_reviewed - reproducible)]
            
            if total_evidence > 0:
                bars = ax5.bar(categories, values, color=['green', 'blue', 'gray'], alpha=0.7)
                ax5.set_title('Evidence Quality')
                ax5.set_ylabel('Count')
                
                # Add value labels
                for bar, value in zip(bars, values):
                    if value > 0:
                        height = bar.get_height()
                        ax5.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.5,
                                f'{value}', ha='center', va='bottom')
        else:
            ax5.text(0.5, 0.5, 'No Evidence\nData', ha='center', va='center')
            ax5.set_title('Evidence Quality')
        
        # 6. Timeline of Verifications
        ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 3])
        if fact_sheet.verification_log:
            verification_dates = [entry['timestamp'][:10] for entry in fact_sheet.verification_log]
            date_counts = {}
            for date in verification_dates:
                date_counts[date] = date_counts.get(date, 0) + 1
            
            if date_counts:
                dates = list(date_counts.keys())
                counts = list(date_counts.values())
                
                ax6.bar(range(len(dates)), counts, color='purple', alpha=0.7)
                ax6.set_title('Verification Timeline')
                ax6.set_xlabel('Date')
                ax6.set_ylabel('Verifications')
                ax6.set_xticks(range(len(dates)))
                ax6.set_xticklabels(dates, rotation=45)
        else:
            ax6.text(0.5, 0.5, 'No Verification\nHistory', ha='center', va='center')
            ax6.set_title('Verification Timeline')
        
        # 7. Fact Details Table
        ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
        ax7.axis('off')
        
        if fact_sheet.facts:
            # Create table data
            table_data = []
            for fact in fact_sheet.facts[:10]:  # Show first 10 facts
                table_data.append([
                    fact.type.value[:10],
                    fact.statement[:50] + ('...' if len(fact.statement) > 50 else ''),
                    fact.status.value,
                    f'{fact.confidence_score:.3f}',
                    len(fact.evidence)
                ])
            
            table = ax7.table(cellText=table_data,
                            colLabels=['Type', 'Statement', 'Status', 'Confidence', 'Evidence'],
                            cellLoc='left',
                            loc='center',
                            bbox=[0, 0, 1, 1])
            
            table.auto_set_font_size(False)
            table.set_fontsize(8)
            table.scale(1, 2)
            
            # Color code by status
            for i, fact in enumerate(fact_sheet.facts[:10]):
                if fact.status == FactStatus.CONFIRMED:
                    table[(i+1, 2)].set_facecolor('lightgreen')
                elif fact.status == FactStatus.CONTRADICTED:
                    table[(i+1, 2)].set_facecolor('lightcoral')
                elif fact.status == FactStatus.PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED:
                    table[(i+1, 2)].set_facecolor('lightyellow')
            
            ax7.set_title('Fact Details (Top 10)', pad=20)
        else:
            ax7.text(0.5, 0.5, 'No Facts Available', ha='center', va='center')
            ax7.set_title('Fact Details')
        
        plt.suptitle(f'Fact Sheet Dashboard: {fact_sheet.metadata.model_name}', 
                    fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
        
        if save_path:
            plt.savefig(save_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
        plt.show()
    
    @staticmethod
    def create_verification_timeline(fact_sheet: FactSheet, save_path: Optional[str] = None):
        """Create detailed verification timeline"""
        
        if not fact_sheet.verification_log:
            print("No verification history to visualize")
            return
        
        fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(12, 8))
        
        # Parse verification log
        timestamps = []
        verifiers = []
        statuses = []
        
        for entry in fact_sheet.verification_log:
            if 'timestamp' in entry:
                timestamps.append(pd.to_datetime(entry['timestamp']))
                verifiers.append(entry.get('verifier', 'Unknown'))
                statuses.append(entry.get('new_status', 'unknown'))
        
        if timestamps:
            # 1. Verification activity over time
            verification_df = pd.DataFrame({
                'timestamp': timestamps,
                'verifier': verifiers,
                'status': statuses
            })
            
            daily_counts = verification_df.groupby(verification_df['timestamp'].dt.date).size()
            
            ax1.plot(daily_counts.index, daily_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2)
            ax1.set_title('Verification Activity Over Time')
            ax1.set_xlabel('Date')
            ax1.set_ylabel('Number of Verifications')
            ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
            
            # 2. Status changes over time
            status_colors = {'confirmed': 'green', 'partially_confirmed': 'yellow',
                           'unconfirmed': 'orange', 'contradicted': 'red'}
            
            for status in set(statuses):
                status_data = verification_df[verification_df['status'] == status]
                status_daily = status_data.groupby(status_data['timestamp'].dt.date).size()
                
                ax2.plot(status_daily.index, status_daily.values, 
                        marker='o', label=status, 
                        color=status_colors.get(status, 'blue'))
            
            ax2.set_title('Verification Status Changes Over Time')
            ax2.set_xlabel('Date')
            ax2.set_ylabel('Count')
            ax2.legend()
            ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
        
        plt.tight_layout()
        
        if save_path:
            plt.savefig(save_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
        plt.show()

        """
        
        # Footer
        html_content += f"""

                    <p><em>Fact sheet generated on {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}</em></p>
                    <p><small>This fact sheet provides verified information about the AI model's capabilities and limitations.</small></p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </body>
        </html>
        """
        
        # Save HTML file
        with open(save_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            f.write(html_content)
        
        return html_content
    
    @staticmethod
    def generate_executive_summary(fact_sheet: FactSheet) -> str:
        """Generate executive summary of fact sheet"""
        
        confirmed_facts = [f for f in fact_sheet.facts if f.status == FactStatus.CONFIRMED]
        contradicted_facts = [f for f in fact_sheet.facts if f.status == FactStatus.CONTRADICTED]
        
        performance_facts = [f for f in fact_sheet.facts if f.type == FactType.PERFORMANCE]
        safety_facts = [f for f in fact_sheet.facts if f.type == FactType.SAFETY]
        
        summary = f"""
EXECUTIVE SUMMARY - {fact_sheet.metadata.model_name}

OVERVIEW:
- Total Facts Documented: {fact_sheet.summary['total_facts']}
- Verification Status: {len(confirmed_facts)} confirmed, {len(contradicted_facts)} contradicted
- Average Confidence: {fact_sheet.summary['average_confidence']:.2%}
- Last Updated: {fact_sheet.metadata.last_updated[:10]}

KEY FINDINGS:
"""
        
        # Performance summary
        if performance_facts:
            confirmed_perf = [f for f in performance_facts if f.status == FactStatus.CONFIRMED]
            summary += f"- Performance: {len(confirmed_perf)}/{len(performance_facts)} performance claims verified\n"
        
        # Safety summary
        if safety_facts:
            confirmed_safety = [f for f in safety_facts if f.status == FactStatus.CONFIRMED]
            summary += f"- Safety: {len(confirmed_safety)}/{len(safety_facts)} safety claims verified\n"
        
        # High confidence facts
        high_conf_facts = [f for f in fact_sheet.facts if f.confidence_score > 0.8]
        summary += f"- {len(high_conf_facts)} facts have high confidence (>80%)\n"
        
        # Recommendations
        summary += "\nRECOMMendations:\n"
        if contradicted_facts:
            summary += f"- Address {len(contradicted_facts)} contradicted facts\n"
        
        unconfirmed_facts = [f for f in fact_sheet.facts if f.status == FactStatus.UNCONFIRMED]
        if unconfirmed_facts:
            summary += f"- Verify {len(unconfirmed_facts)} unconfirmed facts\n"
        
        low_evidence_facts = [f for f in fact_sheet.facts if len(f.evidence) < 2]
        if low_evidence_facts:
            summary += f"- Strengthen evidence for {len(low_evidence_facts)} facts\n"
        
        return summary

    # Create a simple model for demonstration
    class DemoClassifier(nn.Module):
        def __init__(self):
            super().__init__()
            self.fc1 = nn.Linear(784, 128)
            self.fc2 = nn.Linear(128, 64)
            self.fc3 = nn.Linear(64, 10)
            self.relu = nn.ReLU()
            self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.2)
        
        def forward(self, x):
            x = x.view(x.size(0), -1)
            x = self.relu(self.fc1(x))
            x = self.dropout(x)
            x = self.relu(self.fc2(x))
            x = self.dropout(x)
            return self.fc3(x)

    class AdvancedFactSheetFeatures:
        @staticmethod
        def add_fact_relationships(fact_sheet: FactSheet) -> FactSheet:
            """Add relationships between facts"""
            performance_facts = [f for f in fact_sheet.facts if f.type == FactType.PERFORMANCE]
            limitation_facts = [f for f in fact_sheet.facts if f.type == FactType.LIMITATION]
            
            # Link performance facts to related limitations
            for perf_fact in performance_facts:
                for limit_fact in limitation_facts:
                    if 'performance' in limit_fact.statement.lower():
                        perf_fact.related_facts.append(limit_fact.id)
                        limit_fact.related_facts.append(perf_fact.id)
            
            return fact_sheet
        
        @staticmethod
        def calculate_fact_reliability_score(fact_sheet: FactSheet) -> Dict[str, float]:
            """Calculate reliability scores for facts"""
            reliability_scores = {}
            
            for fact in fact_sheet.facts:
                # Base score from confidence
                base_score = fact.confidence_score
                
                # Adjust based on evidence quality
                evidence_bonus = 0
                for evidence in fact.evidence:
                    if evidence.peer_reviewed:
                        evidence_bonus += 0.1
                    if evidence.reproducible:
                        evidence_bonus += 0.05
                    if evidence.type in ['experiment', 'benchmark']:
                        evidence_bonus += 0.05
                
                # Adjust based on verification status
                status_multiplier = {
                    FactStatus.CONFIRMED: 1.0,
                    FactStatus.PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED: 0.8,
                    FactStatus.UNCONFIRMED: 0.6,
                    FactStatus.CONTRADICTED: 0.2,
                    FactStatus.OUTDATED: 0.4
                }
                
                reliability_score = min(1.0, (base_score + evidence_bonus) * status_multiplier[fact.status])
                reliability_scores[fact.id] = reliability_score
            
            return reliability_scores
        
        @staticmethod
        def generate_fact_citations(fact_sheet: FactSheet) -> Dict[str, str]:
            """Generate citation format for facts"""
            citations = {}
            
            for fact in fact_sheet.facts:
                # Generate citation based on evidence
                if fact.evidence:
                    primary_evidence = fact.evidence[0]  # Use first evidence as primary
                    citation = f"{primary_evidence.source}. {fact.statement}. "
                    citation += f"Methodology: {primary_evidence.methodology}. "
                    citation += f"Confidence: {primary_evidence.confidence:.2f}. "
                    citation += f"Date: {primary_evidence.date[:10]}."
                    
                    citations[fact.id] = citation
                else:
                    citations[fact.id] = f"No citation available for fact {fact.id}"
            
            return citations
        
        @staticmethod
        def export_fact_database(fact_sheet: FactSheet, filename: str = "fact_database.csv"):
            """Export facts as structured database"""
            import pandas as pd
            
            fact_data = []
            for fact in fact_sheet.facts:
                fact_data.append({
                    'fact_id': fact.id,
                    'type': fact.type.value,
                    'statement': fact.statement,
                    'status': fact.status.value,
                    'confidence': fact.confidence_score,
                    'evidence_count': len(fact.evidence),
                    'last_verified': fact.last_verified,
                    'context': fact.context,
                    'limitations': '; '.join(fact.limitations)
                })
            
            df = pd.DataFrame(fact_data)
            df.to_csv(filename, index=False)
            
            return df
    
    # Demonstrate advanced features

    class FactSheetComparator:
        @staticmethod
        def compare_fact_sheets(fact_sheets: List[FactSheet]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            """Compare multiple fact sheets"""
            comparison = {
                'models': [fs.metadata.model_name for fs in fact_sheets],
                'total_facts': [fs.summary['total_facts'] for fs in fact_sheets],
                'avg_confidence': [fs.summary['average_confidence'] for fs in fact_sheets],
                'confirmed_facts': [fs.summary['facts_by_status'].get('confirmed', 0) for fs in fact_sheets],
                'contradicted_facts': [fs.summary['facts_by_status'].get('contradicted', 0) for fs in fact_sheets],
                'verification_entries': [len(fs.verification_log) for fs in fact_sheets]
            }
            
            return comparison
        
        @staticmethod
        def generate_comparison_report(comparison: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
            """Generate comparison report"""
            report = "FACT SHEET COMPARISON REPORT\n"

                report += f"  Confirmed Facts: {comparison['confirmed_facts'][i]}\n"
                report += f"  Contradicted Facts: {comparison['contradicted_facts'][i]}\n"

            report += f"  Most Facts: {max(comparison['total_facts'])}\n"
