    def module_4_debugging_guide(self):
        """
        Workshop Module 4: Debugging Generative Models
        """
        print("""
        🔧 MODULE 4: DEBUGGING GENERATIVE MODELS
        =======================================
        
        Common Issues and Solutions:
        """)
        
        class DebuggingGuide:
            def __init__(self):
                self.common_issues = {
                    "mode_collapse": {
                        "symptoms": [
                            "Generated samples lack diversity",
                            "Generator produces same/similar outputs",
                            "Discriminator loss goes to zero"
                        ],
                        "causes": [
                            "Discriminator too strong",
                            "Learning rate imbalance",
                            "Architecture issues"
                        ],
                        "solutions": [
                            "Reduce discriminator learning rate",
                            "Add noise to discriminator inputs",
                            "Use different optimizers",
                            "Apply spectral normalization"
                        ]
                    },
                    "training_instability": {
                        "symptoms": [
                            "Loss oscillations",
                            "Gradient explosions",
                            "NaN values in loss"
                        ],
                        "causes": [
                            "Learning rates too high",
                            "Poor initialization",
                            "Architecture mismatch"
                        ],
                        "solutions": [
                            "Gradient clipping",
                            "Learning rate scheduling",
                            "Better weight initialization",
                            "Batch normalization"
                        ]
                    },
                    "poor_quality": {
                        "symptoms": [
                            "Blurry outputs",
                            "Unrealistic samples",
                            "Low-frequency artifacts"
                        ],
                        "causes": [
                            "Insufficient model capacity",
                            "Poor loss function",
                            "Training time too short"
                        ],
                        "solutions": [
                            "Increase model size",
                            "Better architecture",
                            "Longer training",
                            "Perceptual losses"
                        ]
                    }
                }
            
            def diagnose_issue(self, symptoms):
                """Diagnose issues based on symptoms"""
                matches = {}
                for issue, details in self.common_issues.items():
                    overlap = set(symptoms) & set(details["symptoms"])
                    if overlap:
                        matches[issue] = len(overlap) / len(details["symptoms"])
                
                if matches:
                    best_match = max(matches, key=matches.get)
                    return best_match, self.common_issues[best_match]
                
                return None, None
            
            def create_diagnostic_checklist(self):
                """Create a diagnostic checklist"""
                checklist = [
                    "✓ Check loss curves for both generator and discriminator",
                    "✓ Visualize generated samples regularly",
                    "✓ Monitor gradient norms",
                    "✓ Check for NaN/Inf values",
                    "✓ Validate data preprocessing",
                    "✓ Test different learning rates",
                    "✓ Ensure proper weight initialization",
                    "✓ Monitor training/validation metrics",
                    "✓ Check model architecture compatibility",
                    "✓ Verify data loader functionality"
                ]
                
                print("\n📋 DIAGNOSTIC CHECKLIST:")
                for item in checklist:
                    print(f"  {item}")
                
                return checklist
            
            def interactive_debugging_session(self):
                """Interactive debugging session"""
                print("\n🔍 INTERACTIVE DEBUGGING:")
                print("Describe your symptoms (enter multiple symptoms separated by commas):")
                
                # Simulate user input for demonstration
                example_symptoms = ["Generated samples lack diversity", "Discriminator loss goes to zero"]
                print(f"Example symptoms: {', '.join(example_symptoms)}")
                
                issue, details = self.diagnose_issue(example_symptoms)
                
                if issue:
                    print(f"\n🎯 LIKELY ISSUE: {issue.replace('_', ' ').title()}")
                    print(f"\nPossible causes:")
                    for cause in details["causes"]:
                        print(f"  • {cause}")
                    
                    print(f"\nRecommended solutions:")
                    for solution in details["solutions"]:
                        print(f"  • {solution}")
                else:
                    print("\nNo specific issue identified. Please check the diagnostic checklist.")
                
                return issue, details
        
        guide = DebuggingGuide()
        guide.create_diagnostic_checklist()
        guide.interactive_debugging_session()
        
        return guide

class GenerativeModelCommunity:
    """
    Community features for sharing models, datasets, and best practices
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.model_zoo = {}
        self.dataset_registry = {}
        self.best_practices = {}
    
    def contribute_model(self, name, model, metadata):
        """Contribute a trained model to the community"""
        self.model_zoo[name] = {
            'model': model,
            'metadata': metadata,
            'contributed_by': metadata.get('author', 'Anonymous'),
            'description': metadata.get('description', ''),
            'performance': metadata.get('performance', {}),
            'training_details': metadata.get('training_details', {})
        }
        
        print(f"✅ Model '{name}' contributed to the community!")
        return True
    
    def browse_models(self, filter_by=None):
        """Browse available community models"""
        print("🏛️ COMMUNITY MODEL ZOO:")
        print("=" * 50)
        
        for name, info in self.model_zoo.items():
            if filter_by and filter_by not in name.lower():
                continue
                
            print(f"\n📦 {name}")
            print(f"   Author: {info['contributed_by']}")
            print(f"   Description: {info['description']}")
            
            if info['performance']:
                print("   Performance:")
                for metric, value in info['performance'].items():
                    print(f"     {metric}: {value}")
        
        return list(self.model_zoo.keys())
    
    def get_model_leaderboard(self, metric='fid'):
        """Get leaderboard for specific metric"""
        leaderboard = []
        
        for name, info in self.model_zoo.items():
            if metric in info.get('performance', {}):
                leaderboard.append({
                    'name': name,
                    'score': info['performance'][metric],
                    'author': info['contributed_by']
                })
        
        # Sort by metric (lower is better for FID)
        if metric.lower() in ['fid', 'loss']:
            leaderboard.sort(key=lambda x: x['score'])
        else:
            leaderboard.sort(key=lambda x: x['score'], reverse=True)
        
        print(f"🏆 LEADERBOARD - {metric.upper()}:")
        print("=" * 40)
        
        for i, entry in enumerate(leaderboard[:10], 1):
            print(f"{i:2d}. {entry['name']} - {entry['score']:.4f} ({entry['author']})")
        
        return leaderboard
    
    def share_best_practice(self, category, practice):
        """Share a best practice with the community"""
        if category not in self.best_practices:
            self.best_practices[category] = []
        
        self.best_practices[category].append(practice)
        print(f"✅ Best practice added to '{category}' category!")
    
    def get_best_practices(self, category=None):
        """Get community best practices"""
        if category:
            return self.best_practices.get(category, [])
        
        print("💡 COMMUNITY BEST PRACTICES:")
        print("=" * 40)
        
        for cat, practices in self.best_practices.items():
            print(f"\n📂 {cat.upper()}:")
            for i, practice in enumerate(practices, 1):
                print(f"  {i}. {practice}")
        
        return self.best_practices

# 1. RESEARCH & EXPLORATION
framework = UnifiedGenerativeFramework()

    task_type='high_resolution_images',

)

# 2. MODEL DEVELOPMENT
model, config = framework.create_model('stylegan', custom_config={
    'z_dim': 512,
    'w_dim': 512,
    'img_size': 1024,

})

# 3. TRAINING PIPELINE
pipeline = framework.create_training_pipeline('stylegan', your_dataset, config)
trainer = pipeline['trainer']

# Train with advanced features

    loss = trainer.train_epoch(train_loader, val_loader)
    
    # Auto-save and monitoring
    if epoch % 50 == 0:
        trainer.save_checkpoint()
        trainer.generate_and_save_samples()

# 4. EVALUATION & ANALYSIS

analyzer = GenerativeModelAnalyzer(model)
diversity_metrics = analyzer.diversity_analysis()
mode_collapse_check = analyzer.analyze_mode_collapse()

# 5. OPTIMIZATION
optimizer = GenerativeModelHyperparameterOptimizer(model_factory, train_data, val_data)
best_params = optimizer.optimize(n_trials=100)

# 6. PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT
server = framework.create_production_deployment('stylegan', 'best_model.pth')

# API Integration
app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/generate', methods=['POST'])
def generate_api():
    data = request.get_json()
    batch_size = data.get('batch_size', 1)
    seed = data.get('seed', None)
    
    if seed:
        samples = server.generate_with_seed(seed, batch_size)
    else:
        samples = server.generate_batch(batch_size)
    
    # Convert to base64 for API response
    images_b64 = convert_tensors_to_base64(samples)
    
    return jsonify({
        'status': 'success',
        'images': images_b64,
        'metadata': server.get_model_info()
    })

# 7. MONITORING & MAINTENANCE
@app.route('/health', methods=['GET'])
def health_check():
    return jsonify(server.health_check())

    def bias_detection_tools(self):
        """Tools for detecting and mitigating bias in generative models"""
        
        class BiasDetector:
            def __init__(self):
                self.bias_metrics = [
                    'demographic_parity',
                    'equalized_odds',
                    'individual_fairness',
                    'representation_bias'
                ]
            
            def detect_representation_bias(self, generated_samples, demographic_attributes):
                """Detect bias in representation across demographic groups"""
                bias_report = {}
                
                # Simulate bias detection
                for attribute in demographic_attributes:
                    # In real implementation, this would use computer vision
                    # or other techniques to detect attributes in generated samples
                    representation_ratio = np.random.uniform(0.3, 0.7)  # Simulate
                    bias_report[attribute] = {
                        'representation_ratio': representation_ratio,
                        'bias_score': abs(0.5 - representation_ratio),
                        'status': 'biased' if abs(0.5 - representation_ratio) > 0.2 else 'fair'
                    }
                
                return bias_report
            
            def generate_bias_report(self, model, test_data, demographic_attributes):
                """Generate comprehensive bias report"""
                print("🔍 BIAS DETECTION REPORT")
                print("=" * 40)
                
                # Generate samples for analysis
                num_samples = 1000
                if hasattr(model, 'generate_samples'):
                    samples = model.generate_samples(num_samples)
                else:
                    samples = torch.randn(num_samples, 3, 64, 64)  # Dummy samples
                
                # Detect bias
                bias_report = self.detect_representation_bias(samples, demographic_attributes)
                
                print("\nRepresentation Analysis:")
                for attribute, metrics in bias_report.items():
                    status_icon = "⚠️" if metrics['status'] == 'biased' else "✅"
                    print(f"  {status_icon} {attribute}: {metrics['representation_ratio']:.2f} "
                          f"(bias score: {metrics['bias_score']:.3f})")
                
                return bias_report
        
        return BiasDetector()

            'future_roadmap': GenerativeAIFutureRoadmap(),
            'ethics': EthicalAIGuidelines(),
            'governance': GenerativeAIGovernance(),
            'research': GenerativeAIResearchFrontiers()
        }
        
        self.integration_apis = self._setup_integration_apis()
    
    def _setup_integration_apis(self):
        """Setup APIs for component integration"""
        return {
            'model_lifecycle': self._create_model_lifecycle_api(),
            'knowledge_base': self._create_knowledge_base_api(),
            'collaboration': self._create_collaboration_api(),
            'governance': self._create_governance_api()
        }
    
    def _create_model_lifecycle_api(self):
        """API for complete model lifecycle management"""
        class ModelLifecycleAPI:
            def __init__(self, ecosystem):
                self.ecosystem = ecosystem
            
            def create_project(self, project_config):
                """Create new generative AI project"""
                project = {
                    'id': f"project_{hash(str(project_config)) % 10000:04d}",
                    'config': project_config,
                    'status': 'initialized',
                    'created_at': torch.tensor(0),  # Timestamp placeholder
                    'components': {}
                }
                
                # Get model recommendations
                recommendations = self.ecosystem['core_framework'].recommend_model(
                    project_config.get('task_type', 'unconditional_image_generation'),
                    project_config.get('dataset_size', 'medium'),
                    project_config.get('quality_priority', 'high'),
                    project_config.get('speed_priority', 'moderate')
                )
                
                project['recommendations'] = recommendations
                project['status'] = 'configured'
                
                return project
            
            def setup_training(self, project, dataset):
                """Setup training pipeline for project"""
                model_name = project['recommendations'][0]
                
                # Create model and training pipeline
                model, config = self.ecosystem['core_framework'].create_model(
                    model_name, project['config']
                )
                
                pipeline = self.ecosystem['core_framework'].create_training_pipeline(
                    model_name, dataset, config
                )
                
                project['components']['model'] = model
                project['components']['pipeline'] = pipeline
                project['status'] = 'ready_for_training'
                
                return project
            
            def monitor_training(self, project):
                """Monitor training progress and health"""
                if 'pipeline' not in project['components']:
                    return {'error': 'Training not setup'}
                
                pipeline = project['components']['pipeline']
                trainer = pipeline['trainer']
                
                # Get training metrics
                metrics = {
                    'current_epoch': trainer.current_epoch,
                    'global_step': trainer.global_step,
                    'recent_losses': trainer.metrics_history['train_loss'][-10:],
                    'status': 'training' if trainer.current_epoch > 0 else 'not_started'
                }
                
                return metrics
            
            def evaluate_model(self, project):
                """Comprehensive model evaluation"""
                if 'model' not in project['components']:
                    return {'error': 'Model not available'}
                
                model = project['components']['model']
                evaluator = self.ecosystem['core_framework'].evaluator
                
                # Run evaluation (simplified for demo)
                results = {
                    'fid_score': np.random.uniform(10, 50),  # Simulated
                    'inception_score': np.random.uniform(5, 12),  # Simulated
                    'diversity_score': np.random.uniform(0.5, 0.9),  # Simulated
                    'evaluation_date': 'current_timestamp'
                }
                
                project['evaluation_results'] = results
                project['status'] = 'evaluated'
                
                return results
            
            def deploy_model(self, project, deployment_config):
                """Deploy model to production"""
                if 'model' not in project['components']:
                    return {'error': 'Model not available'}
                
                model = project['components']['model']
                
                # Create production server
                server = GenerativeModelServer(
                    model, 
                    deployment_config, 
                    device=deployment_config.get('device', 'cuda')
                )
                
                project['components']['server'] = server
                project['deployment_config'] = deployment_config
                project['status'] = 'deployed'
                
                return {
                    'status': 'success',
                    'endpoint_url': f"http://localhost:5000/generate",
                    'health_check_url': f"http://localhost:5000/health"
                }
        
        return ModelLifecycleAPI(self.ecosystem_components)
    
    def _create_knowledge_base_api(self):
        """API for accessing ecosystem knowledge base"""
        class KnowledgeBaseAPI:
            def __init__(self, ecosystem):
                self.ecosystem = ecosystem
                self.knowledge_graph = self._build_knowledge_graph()
            
            def _build_knowledge_graph(self):
                """Build knowledge graph of generative AI concepts"""
                return {
                    'models': {
                        'gan': {
                            'variants': ['vanilla_gan', 'dcgan', 'stylegan', 'biggan'],
                            'strengths': ['fast_generation', 'high_quality'],
                            'weaknesses': ['training_instability', 'mode_collapse'],
                            'use_cases': ['image_generation', 'data_augmentation']
                        },
                        'diffusion': {
                            'variants': ['ddpm', 'latent_diffusion', 'conditional_diffusion'],
                            'strengths': ['highest_quality', 'stable_training'],
                            'weaknesses': ['slow_generation', 'computational_cost'],
                            'use_cases': ['high_quality_synthesis', 'inpainting']
                        },
                        'vae': {
                            'variants': ['vae_gan', 'vqvae', 'beta_vae'],
                            'strengths': ['interpretable_latents', 'stable_training'],
                            'weaknesses': ['blurry_outputs', 'posterior_collapse'],
                            'use_cases': ['representation_learning', 'anomaly_detection']
                        }
                    },
                    'techniques': {
                        'progressive_training': {
                            'description': 'Gradually increase resolution during training',
                            'applicable_models': ['stylegan', 'progan'],
                            'benefits': ['faster_training', 'better_stability']
                        },
                        'self_attention': {
                            'description': 'Attention mechanism for long-range dependencies',
                            'applicable_models': ['biggan', 'stylegan'],
                            'benefits': ['global_coherence', 'better_details']
                        }
                    }
                }
            
            def query_knowledge(self, query_type, query_params):
                """Query the knowledge base"""
                if query_type == 'model_comparison':
                    return self._compare_models(query_params)
                elif query_type == 'technique_recommendation':
                    return self._recommend_techniques(query_params)
                elif query_type == 'troubleshooting':
                    return self._get_troubleshooting_advice(query_params)
                else:
                    return {'error': 'Unknown query type'}
            
            def _compare_models(self, models):
                """Compare different model types"""
                comparison = {}
                for model in models:
                    if model in self.knowledge_graph['models']:
                        comparison[model] = self.knowledge_graph['models'][model]
                return comparison
            
            def _recommend_techniques(self, context):
                """Recommend techniques based on context"""
                recommendations = []
                for technique, details in self.knowledge_graph['techniques'].items():
                    if context.get('model_type') in details.get('applicable_models', []):
                        recommendations.append({
                            'technique': technique,
                            'description': details['description'],
                            'benefits': details['benefits']
                        })
                return recommendations
            
            def _get_troubleshooting_advice(self, symptoms):
                """Get troubleshooting advice based on symptoms"""
                # This would integrate with the debugging guide
                debug_guide = self.ecosystem['workshop'].module_4_debugging_guide()
                issue, details = debug_guide.diagnose_issue(symptoms)
                
                if issue:
                    return {
                        'issue': issue,
                        'solutions': details['solutions'],
                        'causes': details['causes']
                    }
                else:
                    return {'advice': 'Please check the diagnostic checklist'}
        
        return KnowledgeBaseAPI(self.ecosystem_components)
    
    def _create_collaboration_api(self):
        """API for collaboration features"""
        class CollaborationAPI:
            def __init__(self, ecosystem):
                self.ecosystem = ecosystem
                self.active_collaborations = {}
            
            def create_collaboration(self, collaboration_config):
                """Create new collaboration project"""
                collab_id = f"collab_{hash(str(collaboration_config)) % 10000:04d}"
                
                collaboration = {
                    'id': collab_id,
                    'type': collaboration_config.get('type', 'research'),
                    'participants': collaboration_config.get('participants', []),
                    'objectives': collaboration_config.get('objectives', []),
                    'shared_resources': {
                        'models': {},
                        'datasets': {},
                        'results': {},
                        'code': {}
                    },
                    'communication_channels': {
                        'forum': f"forum_{collab_id}",
                        'chat': f"chat_{collab_id}",
                        'meetings': []
                    },
                    'status': 'active'
                }
                
                self.active_collaborations[collab_id] = collaboration
                return collaboration
            
            def share_resource(self, collab_id, resource_type, resource_data):
                """Share resource with collaboration"""
                if collab_id not in self.active_collaborations:
                    return {'error': 'Collaboration not found'}
                
                collab = self.active_collaborations[collab_id]
                resource_id = f"{resource_type}_{len(collab['shared_resources'][resource_type])}"
                
                collab['shared_resources'][resource_type][resource_id] = {
                    'data': resource_data,
                    'shared_by': resource_data.get('author', 'anonymous'),
                    'shared_at': 'current_timestamp',
                    'access_level': resource_data.get('access_level', 'read')
                }
                
                return {'status': 'success', 'resource_id': resource_id}
            
            def get_collaboration_status(self, collab_id):
                """Get status of collaboration"""
                if collab_id not in self.active_collaborations:
                    return {'error': 'Collaboration not found'}
                
                collab = self.active_collaborations[collab_id]
                
                status = {
                    'id': collab_id,
                    'participants_count': len(collab['participants']),
                    'shared_resources_count': sum(len(resources) for resources in collab['shared_resources'].values()),
                    'recent_activity': 'simulated_activity_summary',
                    'progress': 'simulated_progress_metrics'
                }
                
                return status
        
        return CollaborationAPI(self.ecosystem_components)
    
    def _create_governance_api(self):
        """API for governance and compliance"""
        class GovernanceAPI:
            def __init__(self, ecosystem):
                self.ecosystem = ecosystem
                self.compliance_records = {}
            
            def run_ethical_audit(self, model, audit_config):
                """Run ethical audit on model"""
                audit_id = f"audit_{hash(str(audit_config)) % 10000:04d}"
                
                # Get bias detector
                ethics = self.ecosystem['ethics']
                bias_detector = ethics.bias_detection_tools()
                
                # Run bias detection
                bias_report = bias_detector.generate_bias_report(
                    model, 
                    audit_config.get('test_data'),
                    audit_config.get('demographic_attributes', ['gender', 'age', 'ethnicity'])
                )
                
                # Check ethical checklist
                checklist_results = self._evaluate_checklist(audit_config)
                
                audit_results = {
                    'audit_id': audit_id,
                    'model_info': type(model).__name__,
                    'bias_report': bias_report,
                    'checklist_compliance': checklist_results,
                    'overall_score': self._calculate_ethics_score(bias_report, checklist_results),
                    'recommendations': self._generate_ethics_recommendations(bias_report)
                }
                
                self.compliance_records[audit_id] = audit_results
                return audit_results
            
            def _evaluate_checklist(self, config):
                """Evaluate ethical checklist compliance"""
                # Simulate checklist evaluation
                return {
                    'transparency': config.get('has_documentation', False),
                    'fairness_testing': config.get('tested_fairness', False),
                    'safety_measures': config.get('has_safety_filters', False),
                    'user_education': config.get('provides_user_guidance', False),
                    'compliance_score': 0.75  # Simulated
                }
            
            def _calculate_ethics_score(self, bias_report, checklist_results):
                """Calculate overall ethics score"""
                bias_scores = [metrics['bias_score'] for metrics in bias_report.values()]
                avg_bias_score = sum(bias_scores) / len(bias_scores) if bias_scores else 0
                
                # Lower bias score is better, so invert it
                bias_component = max(0, 1 - avg_bias_score * 2)
                checklist_component = checklist_results['compliance_score']
                
                overall_score = (bias_component + checklist_component) / 2
                return overall_score
```python
                return overall_score
            
            def _generate_ethics_recommendations(self, bias_report):
                """Generate recommendations based on audit results"""
                recommendations = []
                
                for attribute, metrics in bias_report.items():
                    if metrics['status'] == 'biased':
                        recommendations.append(f"Address bias in {attribute} representation")
                        recommendations.append(f"Consider data augmentation for {attribute} diversity")
                
                if not recommendations:
                    recommendations.append("Model shows good bias metrics - continue monitoring")
                
                recommendations.extend([
                    "Implement regular bias monitoring",
                    "Provide clear AI content labeling",
                    "Establish user feedback mechanisms"
                ])
                
                return recommendations
            
            def get_compliance_dashboard(self):
                """Get governance compliance dashboard"""
                if not self.compliance_records:
                    return {'message': 'No compliance records available'}
                
                dashboard = {
                    'total_audits': len(self.compliance_records),
                    'average_ethics_score': sum(record['overall_score'] for record in self.compliance_records.values()) / len(self.compliance_records),
                    'compliance_trends': 'simulated_trend_data',
                    'recent_audits': list(self.compliance_records.keys())[-5:],
                    'recommendations_summary': self._summarize_recommendations()
                }
                
                return dashboard
            
            def _summarize_recommendations(self):
                """Summarize common recommendations across audits"""
                all_recommendations = []
                for record in self.compliance_records.values():
                    all_recommendations.extend(record['recommendations'])
                
                # Count frequency of recommendations
                from collections import Counter
                recommendation_counts = Counter(all_recommendations)
                
                return dict(recommendation_counts.most_common(5))
        
        return GovernanceAPI(self.ecosystem_components)

    def system_check(self):
        """Perform system check and compatibility verification"""
        print("🔍 SYSTEM COMPATIBILITY CHECK")
        print("=" * 40)
        
        checks = {
            'python_version': self._check_python_version(),
            'pytorch_installation': self._check_pytorch(),
            'gpu_availability': self._check_gpu(),
            'memory_availability': self._check_memory(),
            'dependencies': self._check_dependencies()
        }
        
        all_passed = all(check['status'] == 'pass' for check in checks.values())
        
        for check_name, result in checks.items():
            status_icon = "✅" if result['status'] == 'pass' else "⚠️" if result['status'] == 'warning' else "❌"
            print(f"{status_icon} {check_name.replace('_', ' ').title()}: {result['message']}")
        
        if all_passed:
            print("\n🎉 All systems ready! Ecosystem fully operational.")
        else:
            print("\n⚠️ Some issues detected. Please review warnings above.")
        
        return checks
    
    def _check_python_version(self):
        """Check Python version compatibility"""
        import sys
        version = sys.version_info
        
        if version >= (3, 8):
            return {'status': 'pass', 'message': f'Python {version.major}.{version.minor}.{version.micro}'}
        elif version >= (3, 7):
            return {'status': 'warning', 'message': f'Python {version.major}.{version.minor} (consider upgrading)'}
        else:
            return {'status': 'fail', 'message': f'Python {version.major}.{version.minor} (upgrade required)'}
    
    def _check_pytorch(self):
        """Check PyTorch installation"""
        try:
            import torch
            version = torch.__version__
            return {'status': 'pass', 'message': f'PyTorch {version} installed'}
        except ImportError:
            return {'status': 'fail', 'message': 'PyTorch not installed'}
    
    def _check_gpu(self):
        """Check GPU availability"""
        try:
            import torch
            if torch.cuda.is_available():
                gpu_count = torch.cuda.device_count()
                gpu_name = torch.cuda.get_device_name(0)
                return {'status': 'pass', 'message': f'{gpu_count} GPU(s) available: {gpu_name}'}
            else:
                return {'status': 'warning', 'message': 'No GPU detected (CPU-only mode)'}
        except:
            return {'status': 'warning', 'message': 'GPU check failed'}
    
    def _check_memory(self):
        """Check available memory"""
        try:
            import psutil
            memory = psutil.virtual_memory()
            available_gb = memory.available / (1024**3)
            
            if available_gb >= 8:
                return {'status': 'pass', 'message': f'{available_gb:.1f}GB available'}
            elif available_gb >= 4:
                return {'status': 'warning', 'message': f'{available_gb:.1f}GB available (limited)'}
            else:
                return {'status': 'fail', 'message': f'{available_gb:.1f}GB available (insufficient)'}
        except ImportError:
            return {'status': 'warning', 'message': 'Memory check skipped (psutil not available)'}
    
    def _check_dependencies(self):
        """Check required dependencies"""
        required_packages = ['numpy', 'matplotlib', 'torchvision', 'scipy']
        missing = []
        
        for package in required_packages:
            try:
                __import__(package)
            except ImportError:
                missing.append(package)
        
        if not missing:
            return {'status': 'pass', 'message': 'All dependencies available'}
        else:
            return {'status': 'fail', 'message': f'Missing: {", ".join(missing)}'}
    
    def launch_ecosystem(self):
        """Launch the complete ecosystem"""
        print("🚀 LAUNCHING GENERATIVE AI ECOSYSTEM")
        print("=" * 50)
        
        # Display welcome message
        self.welcome_message()
        
        # Perform system check

_global_ecosystem = None

def initialize_ecosystem():
    """Initialize the global ecosystem instance"""
    global _global_ecosystem
    if _global_ecosystem is None:
        launcher = GenerativeAIEcosystemLauncher()
        launch_result = launcher.launch_ecosystem()
        _global_ecosystem = launch_result
    return _global_ecosystem

def get_framework():
    """Get the unified framework instance"""
    ecosystem = initialize_ecosystem()
    return ecosystem['ecosystem'].ecosystem_components['core_framework']

def get_tutorials():
    """Get the tutorials instance"""
    ecosystem = initialize_ecosystem()
    return ecosystem['ecosystem'].ecosystem_components['tutorials']

def get_community():
    """Get the community instance"""
    ecosystem = initialize_ecosystem()
    return ecosystem['ecosystem'].ecosystem_components['community']

def quick_generate(model_name='dcgan', num_samples=16, **kwargs):
    """Quick generation function for immediate use"""
    framework = get_framework()
    model, config = framework.create_model(model_name, kwargs)
    return model.generate_samples(num_samples)

def quick_train(model_name, dataset, epochs=10, **kwargs):
    """Quick training function for rapid prototyping"""
    framework = get_framework()
    pipeline = framework.create_training_pipeline(model_name, dataset, kwargs)
    
    trainer = pipeline['trainer']
    train_loader = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=64, shuffle=True)
    
    for epoch in range(epochs):
        loss = trainer.train_epoch(train_loader)
        if epoch % (epochs // 4) == 0:
            print(f"Epoch {epoch}: Loss = {loss:.6f}")
    
    return pipeline['model'], trainer

## 391. Sequence Modeling Pattern

```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
import numpy as np
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, Dataset

class SequenceDataset(Dataset):
    """Dataset for sequence modeling tasks"""
    def __init__(self, sequences, targets, seq_length):
        self.sequences = sequences
        self.targets = targets
        self.seq_length = seq_length
    
    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.sequences) - self.seq_length
    
    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        return (
            torch.FloatTensor(self.sequences[idx:idx + self.seq_length]),
            torch.FloatTensor([self.targets[idx + self.seq_length]])
        )

class SequenceModel(nn.Module):
    """General sequence modeling architecture"""
    def __init__(self, input_size, hidden_size, num_layers, output_size, model_type='LSTM'):
        super(SequenceModel, self).__init__()
        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
        self.num_layers = num_layers
        self.model_type = model_type
        
        if model_type == 'LSTM':
            self.rnn = nn.LSTM(input_size, hidden_size, num_layers, batch_first=True)
        elif model_type == 'GRU':
            self.rnn = nn.GRU(input_size, hidden_size, num_layers, batch_first=True)
        elif model_type == 'RNN':
            self.rnn = nn.RNN(input_size, hidden_size, num_layers, batch_first=True)
        
        self.fc = nn.Linear(hidden_size, output_size)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.2)
    
    def forward(self, x):
        # Initialize hidden state
        h0 = torch.zeros(self.num_layers, x.size(0), self.hidden_size)
        
        if self.model_type == 'LSTM':
            c0 = torch.zeros(self.num_layers, x.size(0), self.hidden_size)
            out, _ = self.rnn(x, (h0, c0))
        else:
            out, _ = self.rnn(x, h0)
        
        # Take the output from the last time step
        out = self.dropout(out[:, -1, :])
        out = self.fc(out)
        return out

# Example usage
def train_sequence_model():
    # Generate sample data
    seq_length = 10
    input_size = 1
    hidden_size = 64
    num_layers = 2
    output_size = 1
    
    # Create synthetic time series data
    t = np.linspace(0, 100, 1000)
    data = np.sin(0.1 * t) + 0.5 * np.sin(0.3 * t) + np.random.normal(0, 0.1, len(t))
    
    dataset = SequenceDataset(data.reshape(-1, 1), data, seq_length)
    dataloader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=True)
    
    model = SequenceModel(input_size, hidden_size, num_layers, output_size)
    criterion = nn.MSELoss()
    optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)
    
    # Training loop
    model.train()
    for epoch in range(100):
        total_loss = 0
        for batch_x, batch_y in dataloader:
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            outputs = model(batch_x)
            loss = criterion(outputs, batch_y)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            total_loss += loss.item()
        
        if epoch % 20 == 0:
            print(f'Epoch [{epoch}/100], Loss: {total_loss/len(dataloader):.6f}')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    train_sequence_model()
```

## 392. Autoregressive Pattern

```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
import math

class AutoregressiveModel(nn.Module):
    """Autoregressive model for sequence generation"""
    def __init__(self, vocab_size, embed_dim, hidden_dim, num_layers, max_length):
        super(AutoregressiveModel, self).__init__()
        self.vocab_size = vocab_size
        self.embed_dim = embed_dim
        self.max_length = max_length
        
        # Embedding layer
        self.embedding = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, embed_dim)
        
        # Positional encoding
        self.pos_encoding = PositionalEncoding(embed_dim, max_length)
        
        # Transformer decoder layers
        decoder_layer = nn.TransformerDecoderLayer(
            d_model=embed_dim,
            nhead=8,
            dim_feedforward=hidden_dim,
            dropout=0.1
        )
        self.transformer_decoder = nn.TransformerDecoder(decoder_layer, num_layers)
        
        # Output projection
        self.output_projection = nn.Linear(embed_dim, vocab_size)
    
    def generate_square_subsequent_mask(self, sz):
        """Generate causal mask for autoregressive generation"""
        mask = torch.triu(torch.ones(sz, sz), diagonal=1)
        mask = mask.masked_fill(mask == 1, float('-inf'))
        return mask
    
    def forward(self, x, target=None):
        seq_len = x.size(1)
        
        # Create causal mask
        mask = self.generate_square_subsequent_mask(seq_len)
        
        # Embedding and positional encoding
        x = self.embedding(x) * math.sqrt(self.embed_dim)
        x = self.pos_encoding(x)
        
        # Transpose for transformer (seq_len, batch, embed_dim)
        x = x.transpose(0, 1)
        
        # Apply transformer decoder
        output = self.transformer_decoder(x, x, tgt_mask=mask)
        
        # Transpose back and project to vocabulary
        output = output.transpose(0, 1)
        output = self.output_projection(output)
        
        return output
    
    def generate(self, start_tokens, max_length, temperature=1.0):
        """Generate sequence autoregressively"""
        self.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            current_seq = start_tokens.clone()
            
            for _ in range(max_length - start_tokens.size(1)):
                # Forward pass
                logits = self.forward(current_seq)
                
                # Get next token probabilities
                next_token_logits = logits[:, -1, :] / temperature
                probs = F.softmax(next_token_logits, dim=-1)
                
                # Sample next token
                next_token = torch.multinomial(probs, 1)
                
                # Append to sequence
                current_seq = torch.cat([current_seq, next_token], dim=1)
        
        return current_seq

class PositionalEncoding(nn.Module):
    """Positional encoding for transformer"""
    def __init__(self, embed_dim, max_length):
        super(PositionalEncoding, self).__init__()
        
        pe = torch.zeros(max_length, embed_dim)
        position = torch.arange(0, max_length).unsqueeze(1).float()
        
        div_term = torch.exp(torch.arange(0, embed_dim, 2).float() *
                           -(math.log(10000.0) / embed_dim))
        
        pe[:, 0::2] = torch.sin(position * div_term)
        pe[:, 1::2] = torch.cos(position * div_term)
        
        self.register_buffer('pe', pe.unsqueeze(0))
    
    def forward(self, x):
        return x + self.pe[:, :x.size(1)]

# Example usage
def train_autoregressive_model():
    vocab_size = 1000
    embed_dim = 256
    hidden_dim = 512
    num_layers = 4
    max_length = 128
    batch_size = 32
    
    model = AutoregressiveModel(vocab_size, embed_dim, hidden_dim, num_layers, max_length)
    
    # Generate sample data
    sample_data = torch.randint(0, vocab_size, (batch_size, max_length))
    
    # Training setup
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(ignore_index=0)  # Assuming 0 is padding token
    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.0001)
    
    model.train()
    for epoch in range(10):
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        
        # Input is all tokens except the last
        input_seq = sample_data[:, :-1]
        # Target is all tokens except the first
        target_seq = sample_data[:, 1:]
        
        outputs = model(input_seq)
        loss = criterion(outputs.reshape(-1, vocab_size), target_seq.reshape(-1))
        
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        
        print(f'Epoch {epoch}, Loss: {loss.item():.4f}')
    
    # Generate sample
    start_tokens = torch.randint(0, vocab_size, (1, 5))
    generated = model.generate(start_tokens, max_length=20)
    print(f"Generated sequence: {generated}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    train_autoregressive_model()
```

## 393. Causal Convolution Pattern

```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

class CausalConv1d(nn.Module):
    """1D Causal Convolution layer"""
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, dilation=1):
        super(CausalConv1d, self).__init__()
        self.padding = (kernel_size - 1) * dilation
        self.conv = nn.Conv1d(
            in_channels, 
            out_channels, 
            kernel_size, 
            padding=self.padding,
            dilation=dilation
        )
    
    def forward(self, x):
        # Apply convolution
        out = self.conv(x)
        # Remove future information by cropping the end
        if self.padding > 0:
            out = out[:, :, :-self.padding]
        return out

class CausalConvBlock(nn.Module):
    """Causal convolution block with residual connection"""
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, dilation):
        super(CausalConvBlock, self).__init__()
        
        self.causal_conv = CausalConv1d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, dilation)
        self.batch_norm = nn.BatchNorm1d(out_channels)
        self.activation = nn.ReLU()
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.1)
        
        # Residual connection
        self.residual = nn.Conv1d(in_channels, out_channels, 1) if in_channels != out_channels else nn.Identity()
    
    def forward(self, x):
        residual = self.residual(x)
        
        out = self.causal_conv(x)
        out = self.batch_norm(out)
        out = self.activation(out)
        out = self.dropout(out)
        
        # Add residual connection
        out = out + residual
        return out

class CausalConvNet(nn.Module):
    """Causal Convolutional Network for sequence modeling"""
    def __init__(self, input_size, hidden_channels, num_layers, output_size, kernel_size=3):
        super(CausalConvNet, self).__init__()
        
        self.input_projection = nn.Conv1d(input_size, hidden_channels, 1)
        
        # Stack of causal conv blocks with increasing dilation
        self.conv_blocks = nn.ModuleList()
        for i in range(num_layers):
            dilation = 2 ** i
            self.conv_blocks.append(
                CausalConvBlock(hidden_channels, hidden_channels, kernel_size, dilation)
            )
        
        self.output_projection = nn.Conv1d(hidden_channels, output_size, 1)
    
    def forward(self, x):
        # x shape: (batch, features, time)
        x = self.input_projection(x)
        
        for block in self.conv_blocks:
            x = block(x)
        
        x = self.output_projection(x)
        return x

class TemporalCausalConv(nn.Module):
    """Temporal Causal Convolution for time series prediction"""
    def __init__(self, input_channels, output_channels, kernel_size, num_layers):
        super(TemporalCausalConv, self).__init__()
        
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList()
        
        # First layer
        self.layers.append(CausalConv1d(input_channels, output_channels, kernel_size))
        
        # Hidden layers with exponentially increasing dilation
        for i in range(1, num_layers):
            dilation = 2 ** i
            self.layers.append(
                CausalConv1d(output_channels, output_channels, kernel_size, dilation)
            )
        
        self.activation = nn.ReLU()
        self.batch_norms = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.BatchNorm1d(output_channels) for _ in range(num_layers)
        ])
    
    def forward(self, x):
        for i, (layer, bn) in enumerate(zip(self.layers, self.batch_norms)):
            x = layer(x)
            x = bn(x)
            if i < len(self.layers) - 1:  # No activation on last layer
                x = self.activation(x)
        return x

# Example usage and training
def train_causal_conv_model():
    # Model parameters
    input_size = 1
    hidden_channels = 64
    num_layers = 8
    output_size = 1
    seq_length = 100
    batch_size = 32
    
    # Create model
    model = CausalConvNet(input_size, hidden_channels, num_layers, output_size)
    
    # Generate synthetic time series data
    def generate_synthetic_data(batch_size, seq_length):
        t = torch.linspace(0, 4*3.14159, seq_length).unsqueeze(0).repeat(batch_size, 1)
        # Mix of sine waves with noise
        data = torch.sin(t) + 0.5 * torch.sin(3*t) + 0.1 * torch.randn(batch_size, seq_length)
        return data.unsqueeze(1)  # Add channel dimension
    
    # Training setup
    criterion = nn.MSELoss()
    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)
    
    model.train()
    for epoch in range(100):
        # Generate batch data
        data = generate_synthetic_data(batch_size, seq_length)
        
        # Input is all but last timestep, target is all but first timestep
        input
```python
        input_data = data[:, :, :-1]  # All but last timestep
        target_data = data[:, :, 1:]  # All but first timestep
        
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        
        # Forward pass
        outputs = model(input_data)
        
        # Calculate loss
        loss = criterion(outputs, target_data)
        
        # Backward pass
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        
        if epoch % 20 == 0:
            print(f'Epoch [{epoch}/100], Loss: {loss.item():.6f}')

    model.eval()

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
import math

class WaveNetLayer(nn.Module):
    """Single WaveNet layer with dilated causal convolution"""
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, dilation):
        super(WaveNetLayer, self).__init__()
        self.dilation = dilation
        self.kernel_size = kernel_size
        
        # Dilated causal convolution
        self.dilated_conv = nn.Conv1d(
            in_channels, 
            out_channels * 2,  # For gated activation
            kernel_size,
            dilation=dilation,
            padding=(kernel_size - 1) * dilation
        )
        
        # Skip connection
        self.skip_conv = nn.Conv1d(out_channels, out_channels, 1)
        
        # Residual connection
        self.residual_conv = nn.Conv1d(out_channels, in_channels, 1)
    
    def forward(self, x):
        # Store original for residual
        residual = x
        
        # Dilated convolution
        conv_out = self.dilated_conv(x)
        
        # Remove future information (causal)
        if self.dilated_conv.padding[0] > 0:
            conv_out = conv_out[:, :, :-(self.kernel_size - 1) * self.dilation]
        
        # Split for gated activation
        filter_gate, gate = conv_out.chunk(2, dim=1)
        
        # Gated activation: tanh(filter) * sigmoid(gate)
        gated = torch.tanh(filter_gate) * torch.sigmoid(gate)
        
        # Skip connection
        skip = self.skip_conv(gated)
        
        # Residual connection
        residual_out = self.residual_conv(gated)
        
        return residual + residual_out, skip

class WaveNet(nn.Module):
    """WaveNet model for audio generation and sequence modeling"""
    def __init__(self, in_channels, residual_channels, skip_channels, 
                 num_layers, num_stacks, kernel_size=2):
        super(WaveNet, self).__init__()
        
        self.num_layers = num_layers
        self.num_stacks = num_stacks
        
        # Initial causal convolution
        self.start_conv = nn.Conv1d(in_channels, residual_channels, 1)
        
        # WaveNet layers
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList()
        for stack in range(num_stacks):
            for layer in range(num_layers):
                dilation = 2 ** layer
                self.layers.append(
                    WaveNetLayer(
                        residual_channels, 
                        residual_channels, 
                        kernel_size, 
                        dilation
                    )
                )
        
        # Output layers
        self.end_conv1 = nn.Conv1d(skip_channels, skip_channels, 1)
        self.end_conv2 = nn.Conv1d(skip_channels, in_channels, 1)
    
    def forward(self, x):
        # Initial convolution
        x = self.start_conv(x)
        
        # Accumulate skip connections
        skip_connections = []
        
        # Pass through WaveNet layers
        for layer in self.layers:
            x, skip = layer(x)
            skip_connections.append(skip)
        
        # Sum skip connections
        skip_sum = torch.stack(skip_connections).sum(dim=0)
        
        # Final convolutions with ReLU activations
        out = F.relu(skip_sum)
        out = F.relu(self.end_conv1(out))
        out = self.end_conv2(out)
        
        return out

class ConditionalWaveNet(WaveNet):
    """WaveNet with conditional inputs (e.g., speaker embeddings)"""
    def __init__(self, in_channels, residual_channels, skip_channels,
                 num_layers, num_stacks, condition_channels, kernel_size=2):
        super(ConditionalWaveNet, self).__init__(
            in_channels, residual_channels, skip_channels, 
            num_layers, num_stacks, kernel_size
        )
        
        # Conditional layers for each WaveNet layer
        self.condition_layers = nn.ModuleList()
        for _ in range(num_layers * num_stacks):
            self.condition_layers.append(
                nn.Conv1d(condition_channels, residual_channels * 2, 1)
            )
    
    def forward(self, x, condition=None):
        # Initial convolution
        x = self.start_conv(x)
        
        # Accumulate skip connections
        skip_connections = []
        
        # Pass through WaveNet layers with conditioning
        for i, layer in enumerate(self.layers):
            # Apply conditioning if provided
            if condition is not None:
                cond_out = self.condition_layers[i](condition)
                # Add conditioning to the dilated convolution
                layer.dilated_conv.bias.data += cond_out.squeeze(-1)
            
            x, skip = layer(x)
            skip_connections.append(skip)
        
        # Sum skip connections
        skip_sum = torch.stack(skip_connections).sum(dim=0)
        
        # Final convolutions
        out = F.relu(skip_sum)
        out = F.relu(self.end_conv1(out))
        out = self.end_conv2(out)
        
        return out

# Example usage and training
def train_wavenet():
    # Model parameters
    in_channels = 256  # For mu-law quantized audio
    residual_channels = 64
    skip_channels = 64
    num_layers = 10
    num_stacks = 3
    seq_length = 1000
    batch_size = 8
    
    # Create model
    model = WaveNet(in_channels, residual_channels, skip_channels, num_layers, num_stacks)
    
    # Generate synthetic audio-like data
    def generate_audio_data(batch_size, seq_length, num_classes):
        # Simulate quantized audio data
        return torch.randint(0, num_classes, (batch_size, seq_length))
    
    def mu_law_encode(audio, mu=255):
        """Mu-law encoding for audio quantization"""
        mu = torch.tensor(mu, dtype=torch.float32)
        safe_audio = torch.clamp(audio, -1, 1)
        magnitude = torch.log1p(mu * torch.abs(safe_audio)) / torch.log1p(mu)
        signal = torch.sign(safe_audio) * magnitude
        return ((signal + 1) / 2 * mu + 0.5).long()
    
    # Training setup
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)
    
    model.train()
    for epoch in range(50):
        # Generate synthetic data
        raw_audio = torch.randn(batch_size, seq_length) * 0.5
        quantized_audio = mu_law_encode(raw_audio)
        
        # One-hot encode
        audio_onehot = F.one_hot(quantized_audio, num_classes=in_channels).float()
        audio_onehot = audio_onehot.transpose(1, 2)  # (batch, channels, time)
        
        # Input is all but last sample, target is all but first sample
        input_audio = audio_onehot[:, :, :-1]
        target_audio = quantized_audio[:, 1:]
        
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        
        # Forward pass
        outputs = model(input_audio)
        
        # Calculate loss
        loss = criterion(outputs.transpose(1, 2), target_audio)
        
        # Backward pass
        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()
        
        if epoch % 10 == 0:
            print(f'Epoch [{epoch}/50], Loss: {loss.item():.6f}')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    train_wavenet()
```

## 395. Temporal Convolutional Network Pattern

```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

class TemporalBlock(nn.Module):
    """Temporal block for TCN with dilated convolutions"""
    def __init__(self, n_inputs, n_outputs, kernel_size, stride, dilation, padding, dropout=0.2):
        super(TemporalBlock, self).__init__()
        
        # First dilated convolution
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(n_inputs, n_outputs, kernel_size,
                              stride=stride, padding=padding, dilation=dilation)
        self.chomp1 = Chomp1d(padding)  # Remove future information
        self.relu1 = nn.ReLU()
        self.dropout1 = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        
        # Second dilated convolution
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(n_outputs, n_outputs, kernel_size,
                              stride=stride, padding=padding, dilation=dilation)
        self.chomp2 = Chomp1d(padding)
        self.relu2 = nn.ReLU()
        self.dropout2 = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        
        # Sequential combination
        self.net = nn.Sequential(self.conv1, self.chomp1, self.relu1, self.dropout1,
                                self.conv2, self.chomp2, self.relu2, self.dropout2)
        
        # Residual connection
        self.downsample = nn.Conv1d(n_inputs, n_outputs, 1) if n_inputs != n_outputs else None
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()
        
        # Initialize weights
        self.init_weights()
    
    def init_weights(self):
        """Initialize weights using normal distribution"""
        self.conv1.weight.data.normal_(0, 0.01)
        self.conv2.weight.data.normal_(0, 0.01)
        if self.downsample is not None:
            self.downsample.weight.data.normal_(0, 0.01)
    
    def forward(self, x):
        out = self.net(x)
        res = x if self.downsample is None else self.downsample(x)
        return self.relu(out + res)

class Chomp1d(nn.Module):
    """Remove padding from the end to ensure causality"""
    def __init__(self, chomp_size):
        super(Chomp1d, self).__init__()
        self.chomp_size = chomp_size
    
    def forward(self, x):
        return x[:, :, :-self.chomp_size].contiguous() if self.chomp_size > 0 else x

class TemporalConvNet(nn.Module):
    """Temporal Convolutional Network"""
    def __init__(self, num_inputs, num_channels, kernel_size=2, dropout=0.2):
        super(TemporalConvNet, self).__init__()
        layers = []
        num_levels = len(num_channels)
        
        for i in range(num_levels):
            dilation_size = 2 ** i
            in_channels = num_inputs if i == 0 else num_channels[i-1]
            out_channels = num_channels[i]
            
            layers += [TemporalBlock(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, 
                                   stride=1, dilation=dilation_size,
                                   padding=(kernel_size-1) * dilation_size, 
                                   dropout=dropout)]
        
        self.network = nn.Sequential(*layers)
    
    def forward(self, x):
        return self.network(x)

class TCNClassifier(nn.Module):
    """TCN for sequence classification"""
    def __init__(self, input_size, num_channels, num_classes, kernel_size=2, dropout=0.2):
        super(TCNClassifier, self).__init__()
        
        self.tcn = TemporalConvNet(input_size, num_channels, kernel_size, dropout)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(num_channels[-1], num_classes)
    
    def forward(self, x):
        # TCN expects (batch, channels, sequence)
        if len(x.shape) == 3 and x.shape[1] != x.shape[2]:
            x = x.transpose(1, 2)
        
        # Apply TCN
        tcn_out = self.tcn(x)
        
        # Global average pooling or take last timestep
        pooled = F.adaptive_avg_pool1d(tcn_out, 1).squeeze(-1)
        
        # Classification
        output = self.classifier(pooled)
        return output

class TCNRegressor(nn.Module):
    """TCN for sequence-to-sequence regression"""
    def __init__(self, input_size, num_channels, output_size, kernel_size=2, dropout=0.2):
        super(TCNRegressor, self).__init__()
        
        self.tcn = TemporalConvNet(input_size, num_channels, kernel_size, dropout)
        self.regressor = nn.Conv1d(num_channels[-1], output_size, 1)
    
    def forward(self, x):
        # TCN expects (batch, channels, sequence)
        if len(x.shape) == 3 and x.shape[1] != x.shape[2]:
            x = x.transpose(1, 2)
        
        # Apply TCN
        tcn_out = self.tcn(x)
        
        # Regression output
        output = self.regressor(tcn_out)
        return output

# Advanced TCN with attention
class AttentionTCN(nn.Module):
    """TCN with attention mechanism"""
    def __init__(self, input_size, num_channels, output_size, kernel_size=2, dropout=0.2):
        super(AttentionTCN, self).__init__()
        
        self.tcn = TemporalConvNet(input_size, num_channels, kernel_size, dropout)
        
        # Attention mechanism
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=num_channels[-1],
            num_heads=
```python
            embed_dim=num_channels[-1],
            num_heads=8,
            dropout=dropout,
            batch_first=True
        )
        
        self.layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(num_channels[-1])
        self.output_projection = nn.Linear(num_channels[-1], output_size)
    
    def forward(self, x):
        # TCN expects (batch, channels, sequence)
        if len(x.shape) == 3 and x.shape[1] != x.shape[2]:
            x = x.transpose(1, 2)
        
        # Apply TCN
        tcn_out = self.tcn(x)  # (batch, channels, sequence)
        
        # Transpose for attention (batch, sequence, channels)
        tcn_out = tcn_out.transpose(1, 2)
        
        # Self-attention
        attn_out, _ = self.attention(tcn_out, tcn_out, tcn_out)
        
        # Residual connection and layer norm
        out = self.layer_norm(tcn_out + attn_out)
        
        # Output projection
        output = self.output_projection(out)
        return output

# Example usage and training
def train_tcn():
    # Model parameters
    input_size = 10
    num_channels = [64, 64, 128, 128]
    num_classes = 5
    seq_length = 100
    batch_size = 32
    
    # Create models
    classifier = TCNClassifier(input_size, num_channels, num_classes)
    regressor = TCNRegressor(input_size, num_channels, output_size=1)
    
    # Generate synthetic data
    def generate_classification_data():
        x = torch.randn(batch_size, seq_length, input_size)
        y = torch.randint(0, num_classes, (batch_size,))
        return x, y
    
    def generate_regression_data():
        x = torch.randn(batch_size, seq_length, input_size)
        # Target is sum of input features over time
        y = x.sum(dim=2, keepdim=True)  # (batch, seq_length, 1)
        return x, y
    
    # Training classification model
    print("Training TCN Classifier...")
    criterion_cls = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
    optimizer_cls = torch.optim.Adam(classifier.parameters(), lr=0.001)
    
    classifier.train()
    for epoch in range(50):
        x, y = generate_classification_data()
        
        optimizer_cls.zero_grad()
        outputs = classifier(x)
        loss = criterion_cls(outputs, y)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer_cls.step()
        
        if epoch % 10 == 0:
            print(f'Classification Epoch [{epoch}/50], Loss: {loss.item():.6f}')
    
    # Training regression model
    print("\nTraining TCN Regressor...")
    criterion_reg = nn.MSELoss()
    optimizer_reg = torch.optim.Adam(regressor.parameters(), lr=0.001)
    
    regressor.train()
    for epoch in range(50):
        x, y = generate_regression_data()
        
        optimizer_reg.zero_grad()
        outputs = regressor(x)
        # Transpose output to match target shape
        outputs = outputs.transpose(1, 2)
        loss = criterion_reg(outputs, y)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer_reg.step()
        
        if epoch % 10 == 0:
            print(f'Regression Epoch [{epoch}/50], Loss: {loss.item():.6f}')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    train_tcn()

## 396. Sliding Window Pattern

```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import numpy as np
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader

class SlidingWindowDataset(Dataset):
    """Dataset that creates sliding windows from time series data"""
    def __init__(self, data, window_size, stride=1, target_offset=1):
        self.data = data
        self.window_size = window_size
        self.stride = stride
        self.target_offset = target_offset
        
        # Calculate number of windows
        self.num_windows = (len(data) - window_size - target_offset + 1) // stride
        
    def __len__(self):
        return max(0, self.num_windows)
    
    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        start_idx = idx * self.stride
        end_idx = start_idx + self.window_size
        target_idx = end_idx + self.target_offset - 1
        
        # Extract window and target
        window = self.data[start_idx:end_idx]
        target = self.data[target_idx]
        
        return torch.FloatTensor(window), torch.FloatTensor([target])

class MultiStepSlidingWindow(Dataset):
    """Sliding window for multi-step prediction"""
    def __init__(self, data, input_window, output_window, stride=1):
        self.data = data
        self.input_window = input_window
        self.output_window = output_window
        self.stride = stride
        
        self.num_windows = (len(data) - input_window - output_window + 1) // stride
    
    def __len__(self):
        return max(0, self.num_windows)
    
    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        start_idx = idx * self.stride
        input_end = start_idx + self.input_window
        output_end = input_end + self.output_window
        
        input_seq = self.data[start_idx:input_end]
        target_seq = self.data[input_end:output_end]
        
        return torch.FloatTensor(input_seq), torch.FloatTensor(target_seq)

class SlidingWindowModel(nn.Module):
    """Neural network for sliding window prediction"""
    def __init__(self, window_size, hidden_size, num_layers, output_size):
        super(SlidingWindowModel, self).__init__()
        
        # Feature extraction layers
        self.conv1d = nn.Conv1d(1, 32, kernel_size=3, padding=1)
        self.pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(window_size // 2)
        
        # LSTM for temporal modeling
        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(
            input_size=32,
            hidden_size=hidden_size,
            num_layers=num_layers,
            batch_first=True,
            dropout=0.2
        )
        
        # Output layers
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size // 2),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(hidden_size // 2, output_size)
        )
    
    def forward(self, x):
        batch_size = x.size(0)
        
        # Add channel dimension and apply conv1d
        x = x.unsqueeze(1)  # (batch, 1, seq_len)
        x = torch.relu(self.conv1d(x))
        x = self.pool(x)
        
        # Transpose for LSTM (batch, seq_len, features)
        x = x.transpose(1, 2)
        
        # LSTM forward pass
        lstm_out, _ = self.lstm(x)
        
        # Take the last output
        last_output = lstm_out[:, -1, :]
        
        # Final prediction
        output = self.fc(last_output)
        return output

class AdaptiveSlidingWindow(nn.Module):
    """Adaptive sliding window with learnable window size"""
    def __init__(self, max_window_size, hidden_size, output_size):
        super(AdaptiveSlidingWindow, self).__init__()
        self.max_window_size = max_window_size
        
        # Window size predictor
        self.window_predictor = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(max_window_size, hidden_size),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid()
        )
        
        # Main prediction network
        self.predictor = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(max_window_size, hidden_size),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, output_size)
        )
    
    def forward(self, x):
        # Predict optimal window size
        window_size_raw = self.window_predictor(x)
        window_size = (window_size_raw * self.max_window_size).int()
        
        # Apply adaptive masking based on predicted window size
        mask = torch.zeros_like(x)
        for i, size in enumerate(window_size):
            mask[i, -size:] = 1.0
        
        # Apply mask and make prediction
        masked_input = x * mask
        output = self.predictor(masked_input)
        
        return output, window_size

class SlidingWindowProcessor:
    """Utility class for sliding window operations"""
    def __init__(self, window_size, stride=1):
        self.window_size = window_size
        self.stride = stride
    
    def create_windows(self, data):
        """Create sliding windows from 1D data"""
        windows = []
        for i in range(0, len(data) - self.window_size + 1, self.stride):
            window = data[i:i + self.window_size]
            windows.append(window)
        return np.array(windows)
    
    def create_overlapping_windows(self, data, overlap_ratio=0.5):
        """Create overlapping windows"""
        overlap = int(self.window_size * overlap_ratio)
        stride = self.window_size - overlap
        
        windows = []
        for i in range(0, len(data) - self.window_size + 1, stride):
            window = data[i:i + self.window_size]
            windows.append(window)
        return np.array(windows)
    
    def reconstruct_from_windows(self, windows, original_length):
        """Reconstruct signal from overlapping windows"""
        reconstructed = np.zeros(original_length)
        counts = np.zeros(original_length)
        
        for i, window in enumerate(windows):
            start_idx = i * self.stride
            end_idx = start_idx + self.window_size
            
            if end_idx <= original_length:
                reconstructed[start_idx:end_idx] += window
                counts[start_idx:end_idx] += 1
        
        # Average overlapping regions
        counts[counts == 0] = 1  # Avoid division by zero
        return reconstructed / counts

# Example usage and training
def train_sliding_window_model():
    # Generate synthetic time series
    t = np.linspace(0, 100, 2000)
    data = np.sin(0.1 * t) + 0.5 * np.sin(0.3 * t) + np.random.normal(0, 0.1, len(t))
    
    # Create datasets
    window_size = 50
    dataset = SlidingWindowDataset(data, window_size, stride=1)
    dataloader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=True)
    
    # Multi-step dataset
    multi_dataset = MultiStepSlidingWindow(data, input_window=50, output_window=10)
    multi_dataloader = DataLoader(multi_dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=True)
    
    # Create and train single-step model
    model = SlidingWindowModel(window_size, hidden_size=64, num_layers=2, output_size=1)
    criterion = nn.MSELoss()
    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)
    
    print("Training Single-Step Sliding Window Model...")
    model.train()
    for epoch in range(100):
        total_loss = 0
        for batch_x, batch_y in dataloader:
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            outputs = model(batch_x)
            loss = criterion(outputs, batch_y)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            total_loss += loss.item()
        
        if epoch % 20 == 0:
            avg_loss = total_loss / len(dataloader)
            print(f'Epoch [{epoch}/100], Loss: {avg_loss:.6f}')
    
    # Test sliding window processor
    processor = SlidingWindowProcessor(window_size=20, stride=10)
    test_data = np.sin(np.linspace(0, 10, 100))
    windows = processor.create_windows(test_data)
    print(f"Created {len(windows)} windows from {len(test_data)} data points")
    
    # Test overlapping windows
    overlapping_windows = processor.create_overlapping_windows(test_data, overlap_ratio=0.5)
    print(f"Created {len(overlapping_windows)} overlapping windows")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    train_sliding_window_model()
```

## 397. Rolling Window Pattern

```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from collections import deque

class RollingWindowFeatures:
    """Extract rolling window statistical features"""
    def __init__(self, window_sizes=[5, 10, 20]):
        self.window_sizes = window_sizes
    
    def extract_features(self, data):
        """Extract rolling window features from time series"""
        features = {}
        
        for window_size in self.window_sizes:
            # Rolling statistics
            features[f'rolling_mean_{window_size}'] = pd.Series(data).rolling(window_size).mean()
            features[f'rolling_std_{window_size}'] = pd.Series(data).rolling(window_size).std()
            features[f'rolling_min_{window_size}'] = pd.Series(data).rolling(window_size).min()
            features[f'rolling_max_{window_size}'] = pd.Series(data).rolling(window_size).max()
            features[f'rolling_median_{window_size}'] = pd.Series(data).rolling(window_size).median()
            
            # Rolling technical indicators
            features[f'rolling_momentum_{window_size}'] = pd.Series(data).pct_change(window_size)
            features[f'rolling_volatility_{window_size}'] = pd.Series(data).rolling(window_size).std() / pd.Series(data).rolling(window_size).mean()
        
        return pd.DataFrame(features)

class OnlineRollingWindow:
    """Online rolling window computation for streaming data"""
    def __init__(self, window_size):
        self.window_size = window_size
        self.window = deque(maxlen=window_size)
        self.sum = 0.0
        self.sum_sq = 0.0
    
    def update(self, value):
        """Update rolling window with new value"""
        if len(self.window) == self.window_size:
            # Remove oldest value
            old_value = self.window[0]
            self.sum -= old_value
            self.sum_sq -= old_value ** 2
        
        # Add new value
        self.window.append(value)
        self.sum += value
        self.sum_sq += value ** 2
