import mlflow
import mlflow.pytorch
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
import threading
from contextlib import contextmanager
import git
import yaml

class ModelStatus(Enum):
    """Model status enumeration"""
    DEVELOPMENT = "development"
    STAGING = "staging"
    PRODUCTION = "production"
    ARCHIVED = "archived"
    DEPRECATED = "deprecated"

class ModelFormat(Enum):
    """Model format enumeration"""
    PYTORCH = "pytorch"
    ONNX = "onnx"
    TORCHSCRIPT = "torchscript"
    PICKLE = "pickle"

@dataclass
class ModelMetadata:
    """Comprehensive model metadata"""
    name: str
    version: str
    description: str
    author: str
    created_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime
    status: ModelStatus
    format: ModelFormat
    framework: str
    framework_version: str
    python_version: str
    model_size_mb: float
    parameters_count: int
    input_schema: Dict[str, Any]
    output_schema: Dict[str, Any]
    performance_metrics: Dict[str, float]
    training_config: Dict[str, Any]
    dataset_info: Dict[str, Any]
    tags: List[str]
    dependencies: List[str]
    git_commit: Optional[str] = None
    experiment_id: Optional[str] = None
    parent_model: Optional[str] = None
    checksum: Optional[str] = None

@dataclass
class ModelArtifact:
    """Model artifact information"""
    path: str
    format: ModelFormat
    size_mb: float
    checksum: str
    created_at: datetime

class ModelStorage(ABC):
    """Abstract base class for model storage backends"""
    
    @abstractmethod
    def save_model(self, model: Any, metadata: ModelMetadata, 
                   artifacts_path: str) -> str:
        """Save model to storage"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def load_model(self, model_id: str) -> Tuple[Any, ModelMetadata]:
        """Load model from storage"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def delete_model(self, model_id: str) -> bool:
        """Delete model from storage"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def list_models(self, filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> List[str]:
        """List available models"""
        pass

class LocalModelStorage(ModelStorage):
    """Local filesystem model storage"""
    
    def __init__(self, base_path: str):
        self.base_path = Path(base_path)
        self.base_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.models_dir = self.base_path / "models"
        self.models_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        self.metadata_dir = self.base_path / "metadata"
        self.metadata_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    
    def _get_model_path(self, model_id: str) -> Path:
        """Get path for model storage"""
        return self.models_dir / model_id
    
    def _get_metadata_path(self, model_id: str) -> Path:
        """Get path for metadata storage"""
        return self.metadata_dir / f"{model_id}.json"
    
    def _calculate_checksum(self, file_path: Path) -> str:
        """Calculate file checksum"""
        hash_md5 = hashlib.md5()
        with open(file_path, "rb") as f:
            for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(4096), b""):
                hash_md5.update(chunk)
        return hash_md5.hexdigest()
    
    def save_model(self, model: Any, metadata: ModelMetadata, 
                   artifacts_path: str = "") -> str:
        """Save model to local storage"""
        model_id = f"{metadata.name}_{metadata.version}"
        model_path = self._get_model_path(model_id)
        model_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        
        # Save model based on format
        if metadata.format == ModelFormat.PYTORCH:
            model_file = model_path / "model.pth"
            if hasattr(model, 'state_dict'):
                torch.save(model.state_dict(), model_file)
            else:
                torch.save(model, model_file)
        
        elif metadata.format == ModelFormat.TORCHSCRIPT:
            model_file = model_path / "model.pt"
            if isinstance(model, torch.jit.ScriptModule):
                torch.jit.save(model, model_file)
            else:
                scripted_model = torch.jit.script(model)
                torch.jit.save(scripted_model, model_file)
        
        elif metadata.format == ModelFormat.PICKLE:
            model_file = model_path / "model.pkl"
            with open(model_file, 'wb') as f:
                pickle.dump(model, f)
        
        # Calculate checksum
        checksum = self._calculate_checksum(model_file)
        metadata.checksum = checksum
        
        # Copy additional artifacts
        if artifacts_path and Path(artifacts_path).exists():
            artifacts_dest = model_path / "artifacts"
            shutil.copytree(artifacts_path, artifacts_dest, dirs_exist_ok=True)
        
        # Save metadata
        metadata_path = self._get_metadata_path(model_id)
        with open(metadata_path, 'w') as f:
            # Convert datetime objects to ISO format
            metadata_dict = asdict(metadata)
            metadata_dict['created_at'] = metadata.created_at.isoformat()
            metadata_dict['updated_at'] = metadata.updated_at.isoformat()
            metadata_dict['status'] = metadata.status.value
            metadata_dict['format'] = metadata.format.value
            json.dump(metadata_dict, f, indent=2)
        
        return model_id
    
    def load_model(self, model_id: str) -> Tuple[Any, ModelMetadata]:
        """Load model from local storage"""
        model_path = self._get_model_path(model_id)
        metadata_path = self._get_metadata_path(model_id)
        
        if not model_path.exists() or not metadata_path.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Model {model_id} not found")
        
        # Load metadata
        with open(metadata_path, 'r') as f:
            metadata_dict = json.load(f)
        
        # Reconstruct metadata object
        metadata_dict['created_at'] = datetime.fromisoformat(metadata_dict['created_at'])
        metadata_dict['updated_at'] = datetime.fromisoformat(metadata_dict['updated_at'])
        metadata_dict['status'] = ModelStatus(metadata_dict['status'])
        metadata_dict['format'] = ModelFormat(metadata_dict['format'])
        metadata = ModelMetadata(**metadata_dict)
        
        # Load model based on format
        if metadata.format == ModelFormat.PYTORCH:
            model_file = model_path / "model.pth"
            model = torch.load(model_file, map_location='cpu')
        
        elif metadata.format == ModelFormat.TORCHSCRIPT:
            model_file = model_path / "model.pt"
            model = torch.jit.load(model_file, map_location='cpu')
        
        elif metadata.format == ModelFormat.PICKLE:
            model_file = model_path / "model.pkl"
            with open(model_file, 'rb') as f:
                model = pickle.load(f)
        
        return model, metadata
    
    def delete_model(self, model_id: str) -> bool:
        """Delete model from local storage"""
        try:
            model_path = self._get_model_path(model_id)
            metadata_path = self._get_metadata_path(model_id)
            
            if model_path.exists():
                shutil.rmtree(model_path)
            
            if metadata_path.exists():
                metadata_path.unlink()
            
            return True
        except Exception:
            return False
    
    def list_models(self, filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> List[str]:
        """List available models"""
        model_ids = []
        
        for metadata_file in self.metadata_dir.glob("*.json"):
            model_id = metadata_file.stem
            
            if filters:
                # Load metadata to check filters
                try:
                    with open(metadata_file, 'r') as f:
                        metadata_dict = json.load(f)
                    
                    # Apply filters
                    match = True
                    for key, value in filters.items():
                        if key in metadata_dict:
                            if isinstance(value, list):
                                if metadata_dict[key] not in value:
                                    match = False
                                    break
                            else:
                                if metadata_dict[key] != value:
                                    match = False
                                    break
                    
                    if match:
                        model_ids.append(model_id)
                        
                except Exception:
                    continue
            else:
                model_ids.append(model_id)
        
        return sorted(model_ids)

class S3ModelStorage(ModelStorage):
    """S3-based model storage"""
    
    def __init__(self, bucket_name: str, prefix: str = "models"):
        self.bucket_name = bucket_name
        self.prefix = prefix
        self.s3_client = boto3.client('s3')
    
    def save_model(self, model: Any, metadata: ModelMetadata, 
                   artifacts_path: str = "") -> str:
        """Save model to S3"""
        model_id = f"{metadata.name}_{metadata.version}"
        
        # Create temporary local storage
        import tempfile
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp_dir:
            temp_path = Path(temp_dir)
            
            # Save model locally first
            local_storage = LocalModelStorage(temp_path)
            local_storage.save_model(model, metadata, artifacts_path)
            
            # Upload to S3
            model_s3_key = f"{self.prefix}/{model_id}/"
            
            # Upload model files
            model_local_path = temp_path / "models" / model_id
            for file_path in model_local_path.rglob("*"):
                if file_path.is_file():
                    relative_path = file_path.relative_to(model_local_path)
                    s3_key = f"{model_s3_key}{relative_path}"
                    self.s3_client.upload_file(str(file_path), self.bucket_name, s3_key)
            
            # Upload metadata
            metadata_local_path = temp_path / "metadata" / f"{model_id}.json"
            metadata_s3_key = f"{self.prefix}/metadata/{model_id}.json"
            self.s3_client.upload_file(str(metadata_local_path), self.bucket_name, metadata_s3_key)
        
        return model_id
    
    def load_model(self, model_id: str) -> Tuple[Any, ModelMetadata]:
        """Load model from S3"""
        import tempfile
        
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp_dir:
            temp_path = Path(temp_dir)
            
            # Download from S3
            model_s3_key = f"{self.prefix}/{model_id}/"
            metadata_s3_key = f"{self.prefix}/metadata/{model_id}.json"
            
            # List and download all model files
            response = self.s3_client.list_objects_v2(
                Bucket=self.bucket_name,
                Prefix=model_s3_key
            )
            
            if 'Contents' not in response:
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"Model {model_id} not found in S3")
            
            # Download model files
            model_local_path = temp_path / "models" / model_id
            model_local_path.mkdir(parents=True)
            
            for obj in response['Contents']:
                s3_key = obj['Key']
                relative_path = s3_key[len(model_s3_key):]
                if relative_path:  # Skip directory entries
                    local_file_path = model_local_path / relative_path
                    local_file_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    self.s3_client.download_file(self.bucket_name, s3_key, str(local_file_path))
            
            # Download metadata
            metadata_local_path = temp_path / "metadata" / f"{model_id}.json"
            metadata_local_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            self.s3_client.download_file(self.bucket_name, metadata_s3_key, str(metadata_local_path))
            
            # Load using local storage
            local_storage = LocalModelStorage(temp_path)
            return local_storage.load_model(model_id)
    
    def delete_model(self, model_id: str) -> bool:
        """Delete model from S3"""
        try:
            # Delete model files
            model_s3_key = f"{self.prefix}/{model_id}/"
            response = self.s3_client.list_objects_v2(
                Bucket=self.bucket_name,
                Prefix=model_s3_key
            )
            
            if 'Contents' in response:
                objects_to_delete = [{'Key': obj['Key']} for obj in response['Contents']]
                self.s3_client.delete_objects(
                    Bucket=self.bucket_name,
                    Delete={'Objects': objects_to_delete}
                )
            
            # Delete metadata
            metadata_s3_key = f"{self.prefix}/metadata/{model_id}.json"
            self.s3_client.delete_object(Bucket=self.bucket_name, Key=metadata_s3_key)
            
            return True
        except Exception:
            return False
    
    def list_models(self, filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> List[str]:
        """List available models in S3"""
        model_ids = []
        
        # List metadata files
        metadata_prefix = f"{self.prefix}/metadata/"
        response = self.s3_client.list_objects_v2(
            Bucket=self.bucket_name,
            Prefix=metadata_prefix
        )
        
        if 'Contents' not in response:
            return model_ids
        
        for obj in response['Contents']:
            key = obj['Key']
            if key.endswith('.json'):
                model_id = Path(key).stem
                
                if filters:
                    # Download and check metadata
                    try:
                        import tempfile
                        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='w+', delete=False) as temp_file:
                            self.s3_client.download_file(self.bucket_name, key, temp_file.name)
                            
                            with open(temp_file.name, 'r') as f:
                                metadata_dict = json.load(f)
                            
                            # Apply filters
                            match = True
                            for filter_key, filter_value in filters.items():
                                if filter_key in metadata_dict:
                                    if isinstance(filter_value, list):
                                        if metadata_dict[filter_key] not in filter_value:
                                            match = False
                                            break
                                    else:

                                            match = False

                                model_ids.append(model_id)

class ModelVersionManager:
    """Manage model versioning and lineage"""
    
    def __init__(self, db_path: str):
        self.db_path = db_path
        self.init_database()
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
    
    def init_database(self):
        """Initialize version tracking database"""
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            conn.execute('''
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS model_versions (
                    model_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    name TEXT,
                    version TEXT,
                    parent_model TEXT,
                    created_at TIMESTAMP,
                    status TEXT,
                    promotion_history TEXT,
                    FOREIGN KEY (parent_model) REFERENCES model_versions (model_id)
                )
            ''')
            
            conn.execute('''
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS model_lineage (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    model_id TEXT,
                    parent_id TEXT,
                    relationship_type TEXT,
                    created_at TIMESTAMP,
                    FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES model_versions (model_id),
                    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES model_versions (model_id)
                )
            ''')
    
    def register_model(self, model_id: str, name: str, version: str,
                      parent_model: Optional[str] = None) -> bool:
        """Register a new model version"""
        try:
            with self._lock:
                with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
                    conn.execute(
                        "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO model_versions "
                        "(model_id, name, version, parent_model, created_at, status, promotion_history) "
                        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                        (model_id, name, version, parent_model, datetime.now(), 
                         ModelStatus.DEVELOPMENT.value, json.dumps([]))
                    )
                    
                    # Add lineage relationship if parent exists
                    if parent_model:
                        conn.execute(
                            "INSERT INTO model_lineage "
                            "(model_id, parent_id, relationship_type, created_at) "
                            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                            (model_id, parent_model, 'derived_from', datetime.now())
                        )
            
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            logging.error(f"Error registering model version: {e}")
            return False
    
    def promote_model(self, model_id: str, target_status: ModelStatus,
                     approver: str = "", notes: str = "") -> bool:
        """Promote model to different status"""
        try:
            with self._lock:
                with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
                    # Get current promotion history
                    cursor = conn.execute(
                        "SELECT promotion_history FROM model_versions WHERE model_id = ?",
                        (model_id,)
                    )
                    result = cursor.fetchone()
                    
                    if not result:
                        return False
                    
                    promotion_history = json.loads(result[0])
                    
                    # Add new promotion record
                    promotion_record = {
                        'from_status': None,  # Will be filled from current status
                        'to_status': target_status.value,
                        'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat(),
                        'approver': approver,
                        'notes': notes
                    }
                    
                    # Get current status
                    cursor = conn.execute(
                        "SELECT status FROM model_versions WHERE model_id = ?",
                        (model_id,)
                    )
                    current_status = cursor.fetchone()[0]
                    promotion_record['from_status'] = current_status
                    
                    promotion_history.append(promotion_record)
                    
                    # Update model status and history
                    conn.execute(
                        "UPDATE model_versions SET status = ?, promotion_history = ? WHERE model_id = ?",
                        (target_status.value, json.dumps(promotion_history), model_id)
                    )
            
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            logging.error(f"Error promoting model: {e}")
            return False
    
    def get_model_lineage(self, model_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get model lineage information"""
        try:
            with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
                # Get ancestors
                cursor = conn.execute("""
                    WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS (
                        SELECT model_id, parent_id, 0 as level
                        FROM model_lineage
                        WHERE model_id = ?
                        UNION ALL
                        SELECT l.model_id, l.parent_id, a.level + 1
                        FROM model_lineage l
                        JOIN ancestors a ON l.model_id = a.parent_id
                    )
                    SELECT parent_id, level FROM ancestors WHERE parent_id IS NOT NULL
                """, (model_id,))
                
                ancestors = [{'model_id': row[0], 'level': row[1]} for row in cursor]
                
                # Get descendants
                cursor = conn.execute("""
                    WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS (
                        SELECT model_id, parent_id, 0 as level
                        FROM model_lineage
                        WHERE parent_id = ?
                        UNION ALL
                        SELECT l.model_id, l.parent_id, d.level + 1
                        FROM model_lineage l
                        JOIN descendants d ON l.parent_id = d.model_id
                    )
                    SELECT model_id, level FROM descendants
                """, (model_id,))
                
                descendants = [{'model_id': row[0], 'level': row[1]} for row in cursor]
                
                return {
                    'model_id': model_id,
                    'ancestors': ancestors,
                    'descendants': descendants
                }
        
        except Exception as e:
            logging.error(f"Error getting model lineage: {e}")
            return {'model_id': model_id, 'ancestors': [], 'descendants': []}

class ModelRegistry:
    """
    Comprehensive Model Registry with versioning, metadata management,
    multiple storage backends, and lifecycle management.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, config: Dict[str, Any]):
        self.config = config
        self.setup_logging()
        
        # Initialize storage backend
        self.storage = self._init_storage()
        
        # Initialize version manager
        version_db_path = config.get('version_db_path', './model_versions.db')
        self.version_manager = ModelVersionManager(version_db_path)
        
        # Initialize MLflow if configured
        self.use_mlflow = config.get('use_mlflow', False)
        if self.use_mlflow:
            mlflow.set_tracking_uri(config.get('mlflow_tracking_uri', './mlruns'))
        
        # Model cache for frequently accessed models
        self.model_cache = {}
        self.cache_size_limit = config.get('cache_size_limit', 5)
        self.cache_access_times = {}
    
    def setup_logging(self):
        """Setup logging configuration"""
        logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
        self.logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    
    def _init_storage(self) -> ModelStorage:
        """Initialize storage backend"""
        storage_config = self.config.get('storage', {})
        storage_type = storage_config.get('type', 'local')
        
        if storage_type == 'local':
            return LocalModelStorage(storage_config.get('path', './models'))
        elif storage_type == 's3':
            return S3ModelStorage(
                bucket_name=storage_config['bucket_name'],
                prefix=storage_config.get('prefix', 'models')
            )
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported storage type: {storage_type}")
    
    def _generate_model_id(self, name: str, version: str) -> str:
        """Generate unique model ID"""
        return f"{name}_{version}"
    
    def _get_git_commit(self) -> Optional[str]:
        """Get current git commit hash"""
        try:
            repo = git.Repo(search_parent_directories=True)
            return repo.head.object.hexsha
        except:
            return None
    
    def _calculate_model_size(self, model: Any) -> float:
        """Calculate model size in MB"""
        try:
            import tempfile
            with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile() as temp_file:
                if hasattr(model, 'state_dict'):
                    torch.save(model.state_dict(), temp_file.name)
                else:
                    torch.save(model, temp_file.name)
                
                size_bytes = Path(temp_file.name).stat().st_size
                return size_bytes / (1024 * 1024)  # Convert to MB
        except:
            return 0.0
    
    def _count_parameters(self, model: Any) -> int:
        """Count model parameters"""
        try:
            if hasattr(model, 'parameters'):
                return sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())
            else:
                return 0
        except:
            return 0
    
    def _manage_cache(self, model_id: str, model: Any):
        """Manage model cache with LRU eviction"""
        current_time = time.time()
        
        # Add to cache
        self.model_cache[model_id] = model
        self.cache_access_times[model_id] = current_time
        
        # Evict if cache is full
        if len(self.model_cache) > self.cache_size_limit:
            # Find least recently used model
            lru_model_id = min(self.cache_access_times.keys(), 
                              key=lambda k: self.cache_access_times[k])
            
            del self.model_cache[lru_model_id]
            del self.cache_access_times[lru_model_id]
            
            self.logger.debug(f"Evicted model {lru_model_id} from cache")
    
    def register_model(self, model: Any, name: str, version: str,
                      description: str = "", author: str = "",
                      tags: List[str] = None, 
                      performance_metrics: Dict[str, float] = None,
                      training_config: Dict[str, Any] = None,
                      dataset_info: Dict[str, Any] = None,
                      input_schema: Dict[str, Any] = None,
                      output_schema: Dict[str, Any] = None,
                      model_format: ModelFormat = ModelFormat.PYTORCH,
                      parent_model: Optional[str] = None,
                      artifacts_path: str = "") -> str:
        """Register a new model in the registry"""
        
        try:
            model_id = self._generate_model_id(name, version)
            
            # Create metadata
            metadata = ModelMetadata(
                name=name,
                version=version,
                description=description,
                author=author,
                created_at=datetime.now(),
                updated_at=datetime.now(),
                status=ModelStatus.DEVELOPMENT,
                format=model_format,
                framework="pytorch",
                framework_version=torch.__version__,
                python_version=f"{sys.version_info.major}.{sys.version_info.minor}",
                model_size_mb=self._calculate_model_size(model),
                parameters_count=self._count_parameters(model),
                input_schema=input_schema or {},
                output_schema=output_schema or {},
                performance_metrics=performance_metrics or {},
                training_config=training_config or {},
                dataset_info=dataset_info or {},
                tags=tags or [],
                dependencies=[],
                git_commit=self._get_git_commit(),
                parent_model=parent_model
            )
            
            # Save model to storage
            saved_model_id = self.storage.save_model(model, metadata, artifacts_path)
            
            # Register with version manager
            self.version_manager.register_model(saved_model_id, name, version, parent_model)
            
            # Register with MLflow if enabled
            if self.use_mlflow:
                with mlflow.start_run():
                    mlflow.pytorch.log_model(model, "model")
                    mlflow.log_params(training_config or {})
                    mlflow.log_metrics(performance_metrics or {})
                    mlflow.set_tags({
                        'model_name': name,
                        'version': version,
                        'author': author
                    })
            
            # Add to cache
            self._manage_cache(saved_model_id, model)
            
            self.logger.info(f"Successfully registered model: {saved_model_id}")
            return saved_model_id
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"Error registering model: {e}")
            raise
    
    def load_model(self, model_id: Optional[str] = None, 
                  name: Optional[str] = None, 
                  version: Optional[str] = None,
                  status: Optional[ModelStatus] = None) -> Tuple[Any, ModelMetadata]:
        """Load model from registry"""
        
        try:
            # Determine model_id if not provided
            if model_id is None:
                if name is None:
                    raise ValueError("Either model_id or name must be provided")
                
                if version is None:
                    # Get latest version
                    models = self.list_models({'name': name})
                    if not models:
                        raise ValueError(f"No models found with name: {name}")
                    
                    # Sort by version and get latest
                    model_id = sorted(models)[-1]
                else:
                    model_id = self._generate_model_id(name, version)
            
            # Check cache first
            if model_id in self.model_cache:
                self.cache_access_times[model_id] = time.time()
                # Still need to load metadata
                _, metadata = self.storage.load_model(model_id)
                return self.model_cache[model_id], metadata
            
            # Load from storage
            model, metadata = self.storage.load_model(model_id)
            
            # Check status filter
            if status and metadata.status != status:
                raise ValueError(f"Model {model_id} has status {metadata.status}, not {status}")
            
            # Add to cache
            self._manage_cache(model_id, model)
            
            self.logger.info(f"Successfully loaded model: {model_id}")
            return model, metadata
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"Error loading model: {e}")
            raise
    
    def promote_model(self, model_id: str, target_status: ModelStatus,
                     approver: str = "", notes: str = "") -> bool:
        """Promote model to different status"""
        try:
            # Validate promotion path
            current_model, metadata = self.load_model(model_id)
            current_
```python
            current_status = metadata.status
            
            # Define valid promotion paths
            valid_promotions = {
                ModelStatus.DEVELOPMENT: [ModelStatus.STAGING, ModelStatus.ARCHIVED],
                ModelStatus.STAGING: [ModelStatus.PRODUCTION, ModelStatus.DEVELOPMENT, ModelStatus.ARCHIVED],
                ModelStatus.PRODUCTION: [ModelStatus.DEPRECATED, ModelStatus.ARCHIVED],
                ModelStatus.DEPRECATED: [ModelStatus.ARCHIVED],
                ModelStatus.ARCHIVED: []  # No promotions from archived
            }
            
            if target_status not in valid_promotions.get(current_status, []):
                raise ValueError(f"Invalid promotion from {current_status} to {target_status}")
            
            # If promoting to production, ensure only one production model per name
            if target_status == ModelStatus.PRODUCTION:
                production_models = self.list_models({
                    'name': metadata.name,
                    'status': ModelStatus.PRODUCTION.value
                })
                
                if production_models:
                    self.logger.warning(
                        f"Demoting existing production model(s) for {metadata.name}: {production_models}"
                    )
                    # Demote existing production models
                    for prod_model_id in production_models:
                        self.version_manager.promote_model(
                            prod_model_id, ModelStatus.DEPRECATED,
                            approver, f"Auto-demoted due to new production model {model_id}"
                        )
            
            # Perform promotion
            success = self.version_manager.promote_model(model_id, target_status, approver, notes)
            
            if success:
                self.logger.info(f"Successfully promoted {model_id} to {target_status}")
            
            return success
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"Error promoting model: {e}")
            return False
    
    def delete_model(self, model_id: str, force: bool = False) -> bool:
        """Delete model from registry"""
        try:
            # Check if model can be deleted
            if not force:
                _, metadata = self.load_model(model_id)
                if metadata.status == ModelStatus.PRODUCTION:
                    raise ValueError("Cannot delete production model without force=True")
            
            # Remove from cache
            if model_id in self.model_cache:
                del self.model_cache[model_id]
                del self.cache_access_times[model_id]
            
            # Delete from storage
            success = self.storage.delete_model(model_id)
            
            if success:
                self.logger.info(f"Successfully deleted model: {model_id}")
            
            return success
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"Error deleting model: {e}")
            return False
    
    def list_models(self, filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> List[str]:
        """List models with optional filters"""
        return self.storage.list_models(filters)
    
    def search_models(self, query: str, search_fields: List[str] = None) -> List[str]:
        """Search models by text query"""
        if search_fields is None:
            search_fields = ['name', 'description', 'tags', 'author']
        
        all_models = self.list_models()
        matching_models = []
        
        query_lower = query.lower()
        
        for model_id in all_models:
            try:
                _, metadata = self.load_model(model_id)
                
                # Search in specified fields
                for field in search_fields:
                    field_value = getattr(metadata, field, "")
                    
                    if isinstance(field_value, str):
                        if query_lower in field_value.lower():
                            matching_models.append(model_id)
                            break
                    elif isinstance(field_value, list):
                        if any(query_lower in str(item).lower() for item in field_value):
                            matching_models.append(model_id)
                            break
                            
            except Exception:
                continue
        
        return matching_models
    
    def get_model_lineage(self, model_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get model lineage information"""
        return self.version_manager.get_model_lineage(model_id)
    
    def compare_models(self, model_ids: List[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Compare multiple models"""
        comparison = {
            'models': {},
            'common_metrics': [],
            'metric_comparison': {}
        }
        
        all_metrics = set()
        
        # Load all models and collect metadata
        for model_id in model_ids:
            try:
                _, metadata = self.load_model(model_id)
                comparison['models'][model_id] = {
                    'name': metadata.name,
                    'version': metadata.version,
                    'status': metadata.status.value,
                    'created_at': metadata.created_at.isoformat(),
                    'parameters_count': metadata.parameters_count,
                    'model_size_mb': metadata.model_size_mb,
                    'performance_metrics': metadata.performance_metrics,
                    'tags': metadata.tags
                }
                all_metrics.update(metadata.performance_metrics.keys())
                
            except Exception as e:
                self.logger.error(f"Error loading model {model_id} for comparison: {e}")
        
        # Find common metrics
        if comparison['models']:
            common_metrics = all_metrics
            for model_data in comparison['models'].values():
                common_metrics = common_metrics.intersection(
                    set(model_data['performance_metrics'].keys())
                )
            comparison['common_metrics'] = list(common_metrics)
            
            # Create metric comparison
            for metric in common_metrics:
                comparison['metric_comparison'][metric] = {
                    model_id: model_data['performance_metrics'][metric]
                    for model_id, model_data in comparison['models'].items()
                }
        
        return comparison
    
    def export_model(self, model_id: str, export_path: str, 
                    export_format: ModelFormat = ModelFormat.ONNX) -> bool:
        """Export model to different format"""
        try:
            model, metadata = self.load_model(model_id)
            export_path = Path(export_path)
            export_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            
            if export_format == ModelFormat.ONNX:
                # Convert to ONNX
                import torch.onnx
                
                # Create dummy input based on input schema
                input_shape = metadata.input_schema.get('shape', [1, 784])
                dummy_input = torch.randn(*input_shape)
                
                torch.onnx.export(
                    model,
                    dummy_input,
                    export_path,
                    export_params=True,
                    opset_version=11,
                    do_constant_folding=True,
                    input_names=['input'],
                    output_names=['output']
                )
                
            elif export_format == ModelFormat.TORCHSCRIPT:
                # Convert to TorchScript
                if isinstance(model, torch.jit.ScriptModule):
                    torch.jit.save(model, export_path)
                else:
                    scripted_model = torch.jit.script(model)
                    torch.jit.save(scripted_model, export_path)
            
            else:
                raise ValueError(f"Unsupported export format: {export_format}")
            
            self.logger.info(f"Successfully exported {model_id} to {export_path}")
            return True
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"Error exporting model: {e}")
            return False
    
    def validate_model(self, model_id: str, validation_data: Any = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Validate model integrity and performance"""
        validation_results = {
            'model_id': model_id,
            'valid': True,
            'errors': [],
            'warnings': [],
            'checks': {}
        }
        
        try:
            model, metadata = self.load_model(model_id)
            
            # Check 1: Model loadability
            validation_results['checks']['loadable'] = True
            
            # Check 2: Model structure
            try:
                param_count = self._count_parameters(model)
                if param_count != metadata.parameters_count:
                    validation_results['warnings'].append(
                        f"Parameter count mismatch: expected {metadata.parameters_count}, got {param_count}"
                    )
                validation_results['checks']['structure_valid'] = True
            except Exception as e:
                validation_results['errors'].append(f"Structure validation failed: {e}")
                validation_results['checks']['structure_valid'] = False
                validation_results['valid'] = False
            
            # Check 3: Inference test
            try:
                model.eval()
                input_shape = metadata.input_schema.get('shape', [1, 784])
                test_input = torch.randn(*input_shape)
                
                with torch.no_grad():
                    output = model(test_input)
                
                output_shape = metadata.output_schema.get('shape')
                if output_shape and list(output.shape) != output_shape:
                    validation_results['warnings'].append(
                        f"Output shape mismatch: expected {output_shape}, got {list(output.shape)}"
                    )
                
                validation_results['checks']['inference_test'] = True
            except Exception as e:
                validation_results['errors'].append(f"Inference test failed: {e}")
                validation_results['checks']['inference_test'] = False
                validation_results['valid'] = False
            
            # Check 4: Validation data test (if provided)
            if validation_data is not None:
                try:
                    # Run model on validation data
                    model.eval()
                    with torch.no_grad():
                        if isinstance(validation_data, torch.Tensor):
                            val_output = model(validation_data)
                            validation_results['checks']['validation_data_test'] = True
                        else:
                            validation_results['warnings'].append(
                                "Validation data format not supported for automatic testing"
                            )
                except Exception as e:
                    validation_results['errors'].append(f"Validation data test failed: {e}")
                    validation_results['checks']['validation_data_test'] = False
            
        except Exception as e:
            validation_results['errors'].append(f"Model validation failed: {e}")
            validation_results['valid'] = False
        
        return validation_results
    
    def get_registry_stats(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get registry statistics"""
        all_models = self.list_models()
        
        stats = {
            'total_models': len(all_models),
            'models_by_status': {},
            'models_by_format': {},
            'total_size_mb': 0.0,
            'cache_stats': {
                'cached_models': len(self.model_cache),
                'cache_limit': self.cache_size_limit
            }
        }
        
        # Collect statistics
        for model_id in all_models:
            try:
                _, metadata = self.load_model(model_id)
                
                # Count by status
                status_key = metadata.status.value
                stats['models_by_status'][status_key] = stats['models_by_status'].get(status_key, 0) + 1
                
                # Count by format
                format_key = metadata.format.value
                stats['models_by_format'][format_key] = stats['models_by_format'].get(format_key, 0) + 1
                
                # Sum total size
                stats['total_size_mb'] += metadata.model_size_mb
                
            except Exception:
                continue
        
        return stats
    
    def cleanup_old_models(self, retention_days: int = 90, 
                          keep_production: bool = True) -> List[str]:
        """Clean up old models based on retention policy"""
        cutoff_date = datetime.now() - timedelta(days=retention_days)
        deleted_models = []
        
        all_models = self.list_models()
        
        for model_id in all_models:
            try:
                _, metadata = self.load_model(model_id)
                
                # Skip production models if keep_production is True
                if keep_production and metadata.status == ModelStatus.PRODUCTION:
                    continue
                
                # Skip models newer than cutoff
                if metadata.created_at > cutoff_date:
                    continue
                
                # Delete old model
                if self.delete_model(model_id, force=True):
                    deleted_models.append(model_id)
                    self.logger.info(f"Cleaned up old model: {model_id}")
                
            except Exception as e:
                self.logger.error(f"Error during cleanup of {model_id}: {e}")
        
        return deleted_models

# Example usage
```

import uuid
import time
from enum import Enum

class MetadataType(Enum):
    """Types of metadata that can be tracked"""
    EXPERIMENT = "experiment"
    MODEL = "model"
    DATASET = "dataset"
    TRAINING_RUN = "training_run"
    INFERENCE_RUN = "inference_run"
    PIPELINE = "pipeline"
    ARTIFACT = "artifact"
    METRIC = "metric"
    PARAMETER = "parameter"
    SYSTEM = "system"

class EventType(Enum):
    """Types of events that can be logged"""
    CREATED = "created"
    UPDATED = "updated"
    DELETED = "deleted"
    STARTED = "started"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    FAILED = "failed"
    PAUSED = "paused"
    RESUMED = "resumed"

@dataclass
class MetadataEntry:
    """Base metadata entry"""
    id: str
    type: MetadataType
    name: str
    description: str
    created_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime
    created_by: str
    tags: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    properties: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    parent_id: Optional[str] = None
    version: str = "1.0"

@dataclass
class ExperimentMetadata(MetadataEntry):
    """Experiment-specific metadata"""
    objective: str = ""
    hypothesis: str = ""
    status: str = "active"
    start_time: Optional[datetime] = None
    end_time: Optional[datetime] = None
    results: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

@dataclass
class ModelMetadata(MetadataEntry):
    """Model-specific metadata"""
    architecture: str = ""
    framework: str = "pytorch"
    framework_version: str = ""
    input_shape: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)
    output_shape: List[int] = field(default_factory=list)
    parameters_count: int = 0
    model_size_mb: float = 0.0
    training_time_hours: float = 0.0
    performance_metrics: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)

@dataclass
class DatasetMetadata(MetadataEntry):
    """Dataset-specific metadata"""
    source: str = ""
    format: str = ""
    size_mb: float = 0.0
    num_samples: int = 0
    num_features: int = 0
    schema: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    statistics: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    splits: Dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)

@dataclass
class TrainingRunMetadata(MetadataEntry):
    """Training run-specific metadata"""
    experiment_id: str = ""
    model_id: str = ""
    dataset_id: str = ""
    hyperparameters: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    metrics: Dict[str, List[float]] = field(default_factory=dict)
    epochs_completed: int = 0
    total_epochs: int = 0
    best_metric_value: Optional[float] = None
    best_epoch: Optional[int] = None
    training_time: float = 0.0
    gpu_used: bool = False
    system_info: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

@dataclass
class Event:
    """Event log entry"""
    id: str
    timestamp: datetime
    event_type: EventType
    metadata_id: str
    metadata_type: MetadataType
    details: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    user: str = ""

class MetadataStorage(ABC):
    """Abstract base class for metadata storage"""
    
    @abstractmethod
    def store_metadata(self, metadata: MetadataEntry) -> bool:
        """Store metadata entry"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def retrieve_metadata(self, metadata_id: str) -> Optional[MetadataEntry]:
        """Retrieve metadata entry by ID"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def update_metadata(self, metadata: MetadataEntry) -> bool:
        """Update existing metadata entry"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def delete_metadata(self, metadata_id: str) -> bool:
        """Delete metadata entry"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def search_metadata(self, filters: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[MetadataEntry]:
        """Search metadata entries"""
        pass
    
    @abstractmethod
    def log_event(self, event: Event) -> bool:
        """Log an event"""
        pass

class SQLiteMetadataStorage(MetadataStorage):
    """SQLite-based metadata storage implementation"""
    
    def __init__(self, db_path: str):
        self.db_path = db_path
        self.init_database()
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
    
    def init_database(self):
        """Initialize SQLite database schema"""
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            # Main metadata table
            conn.execute('''
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS metadata (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    type TEXT NOT NULL,
                    name TEXT NOT NULL,
                    description TEXT,
                    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
                    updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
                    created_by TEXT,
                    tags TEXT,
                    properties TEXT,
                    parent_id TEXT,
                    version TEXT,
                    specific_data TEXT
                )
            ''')
            
            # Events table
            conn.execute('''
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    timestamp TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
                    event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                    metadata_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    metadata_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                    details TEXT,
                    user TEXT,
                    FOREIGN KEY (metadata_id) REFERENCES metadata (id)
                )
            ''')
            
            # Metrics table for time series data
            conn.execute('''
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS metrics (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    metadata_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    metric_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                    metric_value REAL NOT NULL,
                    step INTEGER,
                    timestamp TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
                    FOREIGN KEY (metadata_id) REFERENCES metadata (id)
                )
            ''')
            
            # Parameters table
            conn.execute('''
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS parameters (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    metadata_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    parameter_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                    parameter_value TEXT NOT NULL,
                    parameter_type TEXT,
                    timestamp TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
                    FOREIGN KEY (metadata_id) REFERENCES metadata (id)
                )
            ''')
            
            # Create indexes
            conn.execute('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_metadata_type ON metadata(type)')
            conn.execute('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_metadata_created_at ON metadata(created_at)')
            conn.execute('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_metadata_id ON events(metadata_id)')
            conn.execute('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_metrics_metadata_id ON metrics(metadata_id)')
            conn.execute('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_parameters_metadata_id ON parameters(metadata_id)')
    
    def _serialize_metadata(self, metadata: MetadataEntry) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Serialize metadata for storage"""
        base_data = {
            'id': metadata.id,
            'type': metadata.type.value,
            'name': metadata.name,
            'description': metadata.description,
            'created_at': metadata.created_at,
            'updated_at': metadata.updated_at,
            'created_by': metadata.created_by,
            'tags': json.dumps(metadata.tags),
            'properties': json.dumps(metadata.properties),
            'parent_id': metadata.parent_id,
            'version': metadata.version
        }
        
        # Add specific data based on metadata type
        specific_data = {}
        if isinstance(metadata, ExperimentMetadata):
            specific_data = {
                'objective': metadata.objective,
                'hypothesis': metadata.hypothesis,
                'status': metadata.status,
                'start_time': metadata.start_time.isoformat() if metadata.start_time else None,
                'end_time': metadata.end_time.isoformat() if metadata.end_time else None,
                'results': metadata.results
            }
        elif isinstance(metadata, ModelMetadata):
            specific_data = {
                'architecture': metadata.architecture,
                'framework': metadata.framework,
                'framework_version': metadata.framework_version,
                'input_shape': metadata.input_shape,
                'output_shape': metadata.output_shape,
                'parameters_count': metadata.parameters_count,
                'model_size_mb': metadata.model_size_mb,
                'training_time_hours': metadata.training_time_hours,
                'performance_metrics': metadata.performance_metrics
            }
        elif isinstance(metadata, DatasetMetadata):
            specific_data = {
                'source': metadata.source,
                'format': metadata.format,
                'size_mb': metadata.size_mb,
                'num_samples': metadata.num_samples,
                'num_features': metadata.num_features,
                'schema': metadata.schema,
                'statistics': metadata.statistics,
                'splits': metadata.splits
            }
        elif isinstance(metadata, TrainingRunMetadata):
            specific_data = {
                'experiment_id': metadata.experiment_id,
                'model_id': metadata.model_id,
                'dataset_id': metadata.dataset_id,
                'hyperparameters': metadata.hyperparameters,
                'metrics': metadata.metrics,
                'epochs_completed': metadata.epochs_completed,
                'total_epochs': metadata.total_epochs,
                'best_metric_value': metadata.best_metric_value,
                'best_epoch': metadata.best_epoch,
                'training_time': metadata.training_time,
                'gpu_used': metadata.gpu_used,
                'system_info': metadata.system_info
            }
        
        base_data['specific_data'] = json.dumps(specific_data)
        return base_data
    
    def _deserialize_metadata(self, row: tuple) -> MetadataEntry:
        """Deserialize metadata from storage"""
        (id, type_str, name, description, created_at, updated_at, created_by,
         tags, properties, parent_id, version, specific_data) = row
        
        # Parse common fields
        metadata_type = MetadataType(type_str)
        tags_list = json.loads(tags) if tags else []
        properties_dict = json.loads(properties) if properties else {}
        specific_dict = json.loads(specific_data) if specific_data else {}
        
        created_at = datetime.fromisoformat(created_at)
        updated_at = datetime.fromisoformat(updated_at)
        
        # Create appropriate metadata object
        if metadata_type == MetadataType.EXPERIMENT:
            return ExperimentMetadata(
                id=id, type=metadata_type, name=name, description=description,
                created_at=created_at, updated_at=updated_at, created_by=created_by,
                tags=tags_list, properties=properties_dict, parent_id=parent_id,
                version=version,
                objective=specific_dict.get('objective', ''),
                hypothesis=specific_dict.get('hypothesis', ''),
                status=specific_dict.get('status', 'active'),
                start_time=datetime.fromisoformat(specific_dict['start_time']) if specific_dict.get('start_time') else None,
                end_time=datetime.fromisoformat(specific_dict['end_time']) if specific_dict.get('end_time') else None,
                results=specific_dict.get('results', {})
            )
        elif metadata_type == MetadataType.MODEL:
            return ModelMetadata(
                id=id, type=metadata_type, name=name, description=description,
                created_at=created_at, updated_at=updated_at, created_by=created_by,
                tags=tags_list, properties=properties_dict, parent_id=parent_id,
                version=version,
                architecture=specific_dict.get('architecture', ''),
                framework=specific_dict.get('framework', 'pytorch'),
                framework_version=specific_dict.get('framework_version', ''),
                input_shape=specific_dict.get('input_shape', []),
                output_shape=specific_dict.get('output_shape', []),
                parameters_count=specific_dict.get('parameters_count', 0),
                model_size_mb=specific_dict.get('model_size_mb', 0.0),
                training_time_hours=specific_dict.get('training_time_hours', 0.0),
                performance_metrics=specific_dict.get('performance_metrics', {})
            )
        elif metadata_type == MetadataType.DATASET:
            return DatasetMetadata(
                id=id, type=metadata_type, name=name, description=description,
                created_at=created_at, updated_at=updated_at, created_by=created_by,
                tags=tags_list, properties=properties_dict, parent_id=parent_id,
                version=version,
                source=specific_dict.get('source', ''),
                format=specific_dict.get('format', ''),
                size_mb=specific_dict.get('size_mb', 0.0),
                num_samples=specific_dict.get('num_samples', 0),
                num_features=specific_dict.get('num_features', 0),
                schema=specific_dict.get('schema', {}),
                statistics=specific_dict.get('statistics', {}),
                splits=specific_dict.get('splits', {})
            )
        elif metadata_type == MetadataType.TRAINING_RUN:
            return TrainingRunMetadata(
                id=id, type=metadata_type, name=name, description=description,
                created_at=created_at, updated_at=updated_at, created_by=created_by,
                tags=tags_list, properties=properties_dict, parent_id=parent_id,
                version=version,
                experiment_id=specific_dict.get('experiment_id', ''),
                model_id=specific_dict.get('model_id', ''),
                dataset_id=specific_dict.get('dataset_id', ''),
                hyperparameters=specific_dict.get('hyperparameters', {}),
                metrics=specific_dict.get('metrics', {}),
                epochs_completed=specific_dict.get('epochs_completed', 0),
                total_epochs=specific_dict.get('total_epochs', 0),
                best_metric_value=specific_dict.get('best_metric_value'),
                best_epoch=specific_dict.get('best_epoch'),
                training_time=specific_dict.get('training_time', 0.0),
                gpu_used=specific_dict.get('gpu_used', False),
                system_info=specific_dict.get('system_info', {})
            )
        else:
            return MetadataEntry(
                id=id, type=metadata_type, name=name, description=description,
                created_at=created_at, updated_at=updated_at, created_by=created_by,
                tags=tags_list, properties=properties_dict, parent_id=parent_id,
                version=version
            )
    
    def store_metadata(self, metadata: MetadataEntry) -> bool:
        """Store metadata entry"""
        try:
            with self._lock:
